2489 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Float Divide By Zero");
2490 break;
2491 case EXCEPTION_INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO:
2492 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Integer Divide By Zero");
2493 break;
2494 case EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION:
2495 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Illegal Instruction (Invalid or unsupported CPU instruction)");
2496 break;
2497 case EXCEPTION_PRIV_INSTRUCTION:
2498 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Privileged Instruction (Privileged CPU instruction in user mode)");
2499 break;
2500 case EXCEPTION_DATATYPE_MISALIGNMENT:
2501 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Datatype Misalignment (Alignment fault)");
2502 break;
2503 case EXCEPTION_FLT_INVALID_OPERATION:
2504 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Float Invalid Operation");
2505 break;
2506 case EXCEPTION_FLT_OVERFLOW:
2507 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Float Overflow");
2508 break;
2509 case EXCEPTION_FLT_UNDERFLOW:
2510 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Float Underflow");
2511 break;
2512 case EXCEPTION_INT_OVERFLOW:
2513 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Integer Overflow");
2514 break;
2515 case EXCEPTION_IN_PAGE_ERROR:
2516 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("In-Page Error");
2517 break;
2518 case EXCEPTION_NONCONTINUABLE_EXCEPTION:
2519 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Noncontinuable Exception");
2520 break;
2521 default:
2522 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Unknown Code: ");
2523 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendHex_(code);
2524 break;
2525 }
2526
2527 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.finalizeAsNewLine_();
2528 if (::IsDebuggerPresent())
2529 ::OutputDebugStringA(leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.data_());
2530 bridge::sendData(leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.data_(), leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.size_(), true);
2531 return EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER;
2532 }
2533
2534 /// \brief Handles a pure virtual function call as an unrecoverable failure.
2535 [[noreturn]] void pureCallHandler() noexcept
2536 {
2537 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
2538
2539 // Re-Entrancy Guard
2540 if (::InterlockedExchange(&leaked.crash_.crashing_, 1) != 0)
2541 hardFailFast();
2542
2543 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.clear_();
2544 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Runtime Error: Pure Virtual Function Call");
2545 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.finalizeAsNewLine_();
2546 if (::IsDebuggerPresent())
2547 ::OutputDebugStringA(leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.data_());
2548 bridge::sendData(leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.data_(), leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.size_(), true);
2549 hardFailFast();
2550 }
2551
2552 /// \brief Handles an uncaught C++ exception or explicit terminate request.
2553 [[noreturn]] void terminateHandler() noexcept
2554 {
2555 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
2556
2557 // Re-Entrancy Guard
2558 if (::InterlockedExchange(&leaked.crash_.crashing_, 1) != 0)
2559 hardFailFast();
2560
2561 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.clear_();
2562 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Terminate Handler: ");
2563 try {
2564 std::exception_ptr ptr = std::current_exception();
2565 if (ptr) {
2566 try {
2567 std::rethrow_exception(ptr);
2568 }
2569 catch (const std::exception& e) {
2570 // e.what() is not crash-path-safe in the strict sense, but is acceptable here
2571 // because this path handles C++ termination and the caught exception is alive.
2572 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Uncaught C++ Exception: ");
2573 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendText_(e.what());
2574 }
2575 catch (...) {
2576 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Uncaught C++ Exception: Unknown Type");
2577 }
2578 }
2579 else {
2580 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Called without active exception");
2581 }
2582 }
2583 catch (...) {
2584 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Formatting failure while handling terminate");
2585 }
2586
2587 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.finalizeAsNewLine_();
2588 if (::IsDebuggerPresent())
2589 ::OutputDebugStringA(leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.data_());
2590 bridge::sendData(leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.data_(), leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.size_(), true);
2591 hardFailFast();
2592 }
2593
2594 /// \brief Handles an invalid Microsoft CRT parameter as an unrecoverable failure.
2595 [[noreturn]] void invalidParamHandler(const wchar_t* expression, const wchar_t* function, const wchar_t* file,
2596 unsigned int line, uintptr_t /*pReserved*/) noexcept
2597 {
2598 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
2599
2600 // Re-Entrancy Guard
2601 if (::InterlockedExchange(&leaked.crash_.crashing_, 1) != 0)
2602 hardFailFast();
2603
2604 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.clear_();
2605
2606 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("Invalid Parameter Handler; ");
2607
2608 if (expression) {
2609 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_(" Expression: ");
2610 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendText_(expression);
2611 }
2612
2613 if (function) {
2614 if (expression)
2615 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawChar_(';');
2616 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_(" Function: ");
2617 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendText_(function);
2618 }
2619
2620 if (file) {
2621 if (expression || function)
2622 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawChar_(';');
2623 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_(" File: ");
2624 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendText_(file);
2625 }
2626
2627 if (expression || function || file)
2628 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawChar_(';');
2629 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_(" Line: ");
2630 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendDec_(line);
2631
2632 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.finalizeAsNewLine_();
2633 if (::IsDebuggerPresent())
2634 ::OutputDebugStringA(leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.data_());
2635 bridge::sendData(leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.data_(), leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.size_(), true);
2636 hardFailFast();
2637 }
2638
2639 /// \brief Restores the default signal action and raises the signal again.
2640 [[noreturn]] void reraiseDefault(int signum) noexcept
2641 {
2642 if (std::signal(signum, SIG_DFL) == SIG_ERR)
2643 hardFailFast();
2644 (void)std::raise(signum);
2645 // If the default action did not terminate (or raise returned for any reason),
2646 hardFailFast();
2647 }
2648
2649 /// \brief Formats a supported C signal and terminates through the crash path.
2650 [[noreturn]] void signalHandler(int signum) noexcept
2651 {
2652 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
2653
2654 if (::InterlockedExchange(&leaked.crash_.inSignal_, 1) != 0)
2655 hardFailFast();
2656
2657 // This handler is expected to be installed only for SIGABRT.
2658 if (signum != SIGABRT)
2659 reraiseDefault(signum);
2660
2661 // Known "fatal log -> abort()" path: do not write crash log, just let default happen.
2662 if (leaked.crash_.fatalOwnerThreadId_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 0)
2663 reraiseDefault(SIGABRT);
2664
2665 // Absolute recursion stopper: any re-entry => immediate termination.
2666 if (::InterlockedExchange(&leaked.crash_.crashing_, 1) != 0)
2667 hardFailFast();
2668
2669 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.clear_();
2670 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("C Runtime Signal: [");
2671 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendDec_(signum);
2672 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.appendRawText_("] SIGABRT: Abnormal termination (e.g. abort() or failed assert).");
2673
2674 leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.finalizeAsNewLine_();
2675 if (::IsDebuggerPresent())
2676 ::OutputDebugStringA(leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.data_());
2677 bridge::sendData(leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.data_(), leaked.crash_.crashBuf_.size_(), true);
2678
2679 // Preserve default abort semantics (WER/debugger/etc.).
2680 reraiseDefault(SIGABRT);
2681 }
2682
2683 /// \brief Installs Windows, C++, CRT, and signal-level crash handlers.
2684 void installCrashHandlers() noexcept
2685 {
2686 // 1. Windows Hardware Exceptions (SEH)
2687 ::SetUnhandledExceptionFilter(windowsExceptionFilter);
2688 // 2. C++ Uncaught Exceptions
2689 std::set_terminate(terminateHandler);
2690 // 3. Pure Virtual Calls
2691 _set_purecall_handler(pureCallHandler);
2692 // 4. Invalid Parameters (CRT)
2693 _set_invalid_parameter_handler(invalidParamHandler);
2694 // 5. Abort Signal
2695 (void)std::signal(SIGABRT, signalHandler);
2696 }
2697 }
2698
2699 /**
2700 * \brief Normalizes field lists and packs field order into atomic values.
2701 * \details
2702 * Each field occupies a four-bit slot in a 64-bit value so workers can detect and
2703 * apply layout changes without locking.
2704 */
2705 namespace layout
2706 {
2707 constexpr std::uint32_t fieldBits = 4u; ///< Each field uses 4 bits
2708 constexpr std::uint32_t maxFields = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(magic_enum::enum_count<Field>());
2709 ///< maximum number of fields, depends on Field enum size
2710 constexpr std::uint32_t maxPackedSlots = 64u / fieldBits; ///< Maximum slots for a packed 64-bit value (16 slots)
2711 constexpr std::uint64_t fieldMask = 0xFULL; ///< Field mask to read one 4-bit field from packed fields
2712 constexpr std::uint8_t nullField = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(fieldMask);
2713 ///< Unused/empty packed field slot, 0xF = bin 1111 = dec 15
2714
2715 static_assert(maxFields <= nullField);
2716 static_assert(maxFields <= maxPackedSlots);
2717
2718 static_assert(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Field::DateTime) == 0u);
2719 static_assert(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Field::Function) == maxFields - 1u);
2720
2721 /// \brief Stores one unpacked field identifier for each supported field position.
2722 using FieldArray = std::array<std::uint8_t, maxFields>;
2723
2724 /// \brief Packs one unique field into the next four-bit layout slot.
2725 void packField(std::uint8_t field, std::uint32_t& index, std::uint32_t& seen, std::uint64_t& destination) noexcept
2726 {
2727 if (index >= maxFields || field >= maxFields) return;
2728
2729 const std::uint32_t curPos = 1u << field; // set the bit for current field
2730 if ((seen & curPos) != 0u) return; // bitwise AND checks if that bit is already present in seen
2731 seen |= curPos; // bitwise OR sets the bit in seen for next iteration
2732
2733 // Figure out which index the 4 bits representing field would go, for this,
2734 // since each field occupies 4 bits, we shift by 4 * index. Casting before
2735 // multiplication ensures the multiplication is performed using std::uint64_t.
2736 const std::uint64_t shift = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(index) * fieldBits;
2737
2738 // Since fieldMask is 0xFULL i.e. only lowest 4 bits (i.e. the right side ones)
2739 // are 1111, all others are 0. So we shift it to desired position and then negate
2740 // it, this flips all bits, making the current position bits as 0000. Then we do
2741 // bitwise AND, in which case a mask bit of 1 preserves the destination bit and
2742 // a mask bit of 0 clears the destination bit. So, effectively we clear the 4 bits
2743 // in the destination for the given index.
2744 destination &= ~(fieldMask << shift);
2745
2746 // Now we shift the field bits into correct position and we bitwise OR to set these
2747 // bits in the correct index position in the destination. here we are casting field
2748 // to std::uint64_t because destination is std::uint64_t. Above we did not cast the
2749 // fieldMask to std::uint64_t because it is already std::uint64_t.
2750 destination |= static_cast<std::uint64_t>(field) << shift;
2751
2752 ++index;
2753 }
2754
2755 /// \brief Reads one packed field while rejecting duplicates and invalid values.
2756 std::uint8_t unpackField(std::uint32_t index, std::uint32_t& seen, std::uint64_t source) noexcept
2757 {
2758 if (index >= maxPackedSlots) return nullField;
2759
2760 // Here we do the move the bits to the right for the given index. After
2761 // (source >> (index * fieldBits)) the bits at the index will occupy
2762 // the lowest i.e. right-most 4 bits. Then we use bitwise AND with
2763 // fieldMask, which has only the right-most 4 bits as 1 to clear all
2764 // other bits except for the right-most 4 bits. That becomes our value
2765 // for the field.
2766 const std::uint64_t shift = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(index) * fieldBits;
2767 const std::uint64_t value = (source >> shift) & fieldMask;
2768 if (value >= maxFields) return nullField;
2769
2770 const std::uint32_t curPos = 1u << static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value);
2771 if ((seen & curPos) != 0u) return nullField;
2772 seen |= curPos;
2773
2774 return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value);
2775 }
2776
2777 /// \brief Normalizes user field text and optionally publishes its packed layout.
2778 QString normalizeAndPackFields(const QString& source, const QList<Field>& defFields,
2779 std::atomic_uint64_t* destination = nullptr)
2780 {
2781 QList<Field> fields;
2782 const auto strList = source.split(' ', Qt::SkipEmptyParts);
2783 for (const QString& str : strList) {
2784 const auto field = magic_enum::enum_cast<Field>(str.toStdString(),
2785 magic_enum::case_insensitive);
2786 if (field && !fields.contains(*field))
2787 fields.append(*field);
2788 }
2789
2790 if (fields.isEmpty()) {
2791 for (const Field field : defFields) {
2792 const auto val = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(field);
2793 if (val >= maxFields || fields.contains(field)) continue;
2794 fields.append(field);
2795 }
2796 }
2797
2798 // Final fallback, message is always added at the end when formatting
2799 if (fields.isEmpty()) fields << Field::Level;
2800
2801 std::uint64_t packed = nullPackedFields;
2802 std::uint32_t index = 0u;
2803 std::uint32_t seen = 0u;
2804
2805 // We create the normalized packed layout always since it doesn't cost much
2806 // and publish it only when provided destination is not null.
2807
2808 QStringList normalized;
2809 normalized.reserve(fields.size());
2810 for (const Field field : fields) {
2811 const auto name = magic_enum::enum_name(field);
2812 if (name.empty()) continue;
2813 packField(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(field), index, seen, packed);
2814 normalized.append(QLatin1StringView{
2815 name.data(),
2816 static_cast<qsizetype>(name.size())
2817 });
2818 }
2819
2820 if (destination != nullptr)
2821 destination->store(packed, std::memory_order_release);
2822
2823 return normalized.join(' ');
2824 }
2825
2826 /// \brief Expands the current packed field layout for worker-side formatting.
2827 /// \details This function is used by file and display workers to expand the
2828 /// packed atomic layout in an array so that it can be used for formatting.
2829 void unpackFields(const std::atomic_uint64_t& source, FieldArray& destination) noexcept
2830 {
2831 destination.fill(nullField);
2832 const std::uint64_t packed = source.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
2833 std::uint32_t count = 0u;
2834 std::uint32_t seen = 0u;
2835
2836 for (std::uint32_t ii = 0; ii < maxPackedSlots; ++ii) {
2837 if (const auto val = unpackField(ii, seen, packed); val < maxFields) {
2838 destination[count] = val;
2839 ++count;
2840 }
2841 }
2842
2843 // Final fallback, message is always added at the end when formatting
2844 if (count == 0u)
2845 destination[0] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Field::Level);
2846 }
2847 }
2848
2849 /**
2850 * \brief Converts captured records into sanitized normal and important log lines.
2851 */
2852 namespace format
2853 {
2854 // constexpr namespace-scope constants: no meaningful destructor. In many cases the compiler
2855 // may not even allocate storage for them unless their address is taken. Safe to treat as
2856 // permanently available.
2857 constexpr char invalidDateTime[] = "----.--.-- --:--:--.---"; ///< Text for invalid date time value
2858 constexpr char invalidTimeDelta[] = "---.--"; ///< Text for invalid time delta value
2859 constexpr char maxElapsedTimeMsText[] = "999:59:59.999"; ///< Text for maximum elapsed time
2860
2861 inline constexpr std::uint32_t maxElapsedTimeMs{((999U * 60U * 60U) + (59U * 60U) + 59U) * 1000U + 999U};
2862 ///< Maximum possible elapsed time, used for AppTime and ThreadTime
2863
2864 /// \brief Describes one elapsed-time unit during fixed-width formatting of time delta.
2865 struct UnitInfo {
2866 std::int64_t scaleNs_;
2867 char suffix_;
2868 };
2869
2870 /// \brief All available time-delta units and their scales.
2871 constexpr std::array<UnitInfo, 5> deltaUnits{
2872 {
2873 {.scaleNs_ = 100, .suffix_ = 'u'}, // 0.1 us
2874 {.scaleNs_ = 100000, .suffix_ = 'z'}, // 0.1 ms
2875 {.scaleNs_ = 100000000, .suffix_ = 's'}, // 0.1 s
2876 {.scaleNs_ = 6000000000, .suffix_ = 'm'}, // 0.1 min
2877 {.scaleNs_ = 360000000000, .suffix_ = 'h'} // 0.1 hour
2878 }
2879 };
2880
2881 /// \brief Caches the formatted local date and timezone for repeated timestamps.
2882 struct DateTimeCache {
2883 bool valid_{false};
2884 std::time_t sec_{};
2885 char text_[20]{};
2886 };
2887
2888 /// \brief Appends a local timestamp with millisecond precision and timezone text.
2889 /// \details A worker-local cache avoids repeated local-time conversion for records
2890 /// within the same second. Important-log formatting omits the cache because that
2891 /// path does not own worker-local mutable state.
2892 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
2893 bool appendDateTime(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep,
2894 DateTimeCache* cache = nullptr) noexcept
2895 {
2896 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep))
2897 return false;
2898 if (!buf.canAppend_(23))
2899 return false;
2900
2901 if (log.dateTime_ == nullDateTime)
2902 return buf.appendRawText_(invalidDateTime);
2903
2904 const auto secTp = std::chrono::floor<std::chrono::seconds>(log.dateTime_);
2905 const std::time_t sec = std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t(secTp);
2906
2907 const bool useCache = cache != nullptr;
2908 const bool cacheHit = useCache && cache->valid_ && cache->sec_ == sec;
2909
2910 bool ok = true;
2911
2912 // The initial 23-byte capacity check guarantees the following fixed-width appends.
2913 if (cacheHit) {
2914 ok = buf.appendRawText_(cache->text_, 19);
2915 }
2916 else {
2917 std::tm tmValue{};
2918
2919 if (::localtime_s(&tmValue, &sec) != 0)
2920 return buf.appendRawText_(invalidDateTime);
2921
2922 const auto begPos = buf.size_();
2923
2924 ok = ok && buf.appendDigits_(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(tmValue.tm_year + 1900), 4);
2925 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_('.');
2926 ok = ok && buf.appendDigits_(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(tmValue.tm_mon + 1), 2);
2927 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_('.');
2928 ok = ok && buf.appendDigits_(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(tmValue.tm_mday), 2);
2929 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(' ');
2930 ok = ok && buf.appendDigits_(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(tmValue.tm_hour), 2);
2931 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(':');
2932 ok = ok && buf.appendDigits_(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(tmValue.tm_min), 2);
2933 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(':');
2934 ok = ok && buf.appendDigits_(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(tmValue.tm_sec), 2);
2935
2936 if (useCache && ok && buf.size_() - begPos == 19) {
2937 std::memcpy(cache->text_, buf.data_() + begPos, 19);
2938 cache->sec_ = sec;
2939 cache->valid_ = true;
2940 }
2941 }
2942
2943 std::int64_t msPart = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(log.dateTime_ - secTp).count();
2944
2945 if (msPart < 0)
2946 msPart = 0;
2947 else if (msPart > 999)
2948 msPart %= 1000;
2949
2950 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_('.');
2951 ok = ok && buf.appendDigits_(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(msPart), 3);
2952 return ok;
2953 }
2954
2955 /// \brief Appends the fixed-width log sequence field.
2956 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
2957 bool appendSequence(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep) noexcept
2958 {
2959 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep))
2960 return false;
2961 if (!buf.canAppend_(10))
2962 return false;
2963 return buf.appendDigits_(log.sequence_, 10, '.');
2964 }
2965
2966 /// \brief Appends the normalized log-level field.
2967 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
2968 bool appendLevel(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep) noexcept
2969 {
2970 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep)) return false;
2971 switch (log.level_) {
2972 case 0: return buf.appendRawText_("DBUG");
2973 case 1: return buf.appendRawText_("INFO");
2974 case 2: return buf.appendRawText_("WARN");
2975 case 3: return buf.appendRawText_("CRIT");
2976 case 4: return buf.appendRawText_("FATL");
2977 default: return buf.appendRawText_("????");
2978 }
2979 }
2980
2981 /// \brief Appends the compact per-thread index field.
2982 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
2983 bool appendThreadIndex(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep) noexcept
2984 {
2985 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep))
2986 return false;
2987 if (log.threadIdx_ == 0)
2988 // 0 means not assigned, usually only in synthetic logs generated by file and display workers.
2989 return buf.appendRawText_("T#.????");
2990 if (log.threadIdx_ == 1) // 1 is reserved for main thread and so is formatted differently.
2991 return buf.appendRawText_("T#.MAIN");
2992 if (!buf.canAppend_(7))
2993 return false;
2994 if (!buf.appendRawText_("T#"))
2995 return false;
2996 return buf.appendDigits_(log.threadIdx_, 5, '.');
2997 }
2998
2999 /// \brief Appends the Windows thread identifier field.
3000 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3001 bool appendThreadId(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep) noexcept
3002 {
3003 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep))
3004 return false;
3005 if (log.threadId_ == LeakedState::Inst_().mainThreadId_)
3006 return buf.appendRawText_("[--MAIN--]"); // Main thread uses different text for easier identification.
3007 return buf.appendHex_(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(log.threadId_));
3008 }
3009
3010 /// \brief Appends a saturated fixed-width elapsed-time value in format `hhh:mm:ss.zzz`, where `zzz` is milliseconds.
3011 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3012 bool appendElapsedTime(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, std::uint32_t timeMs) noexcept
3013 {
3014 // If elapsed time is more than maximum that can be shown then directly
3015 // append maximum value which is already stored as text and return.
3016 if (timeMs > maxElapsedTimeMs)
3017 return buf.appendRawText_(maxElapsedTimeMsText);
3018
3019 if (!buf.canAppend_(13)) return false;
3020
3021 const std::uint32_t milliseconds = timeMs % 1000U;
3022 const std::uint32_t totalSeconds = timeMs / 1000U;
3023 const std::uint32_t seconds = totalSeconds % 60U;
3024 const std::uint32_t totalMinutes = totalSeconds / 60U;
3025 const std::uint32_t minutes = totalMinutes % 60U;
3026 const std::uint32_t hours = totalMinutes / 60U;
3027
3028 bool ok = buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + ((hours / 100U) % 10U)));
3029 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + ((hours / 10U) % 10U)));
3030 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + (hours % 10U)));
3031
3032 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(':');
3033
3034 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + ((minutes / 10U) % 10U)));
3035 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + (minutes % 10U)));
3036
3037 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(':');
3038
3039 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + ((seconds / 10U) % 10U)));
3040 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + (seconds % 10U)));
3041
3042 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_('.');
3043
3044 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + ((milliseconds / 100U) % 10U)));
3045 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + ((milliseconds / 10U) % 10U)));
3046 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + (milliseconds % 10U)));
3047
3048 return ok;
3049 }
3050
3051 /// \brief Appends elapsed time since logging-system startup.
3052 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3053 bool appendAppTime(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep) noexcept
3054 {
3055 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep))
3056 return false;
3057 if (!buf.canAppend_(15))
3058 return false;
3059 if (!buf.appendRawText_("A="))
3060 return false;
3061 return appendElapsedTime(buf, log.appTimeMs_);
3062 }
3063
3064 /// \brief Appends elapsed time since the current thread first logged.
3065 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3066 bool appendThreadTime(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep) noexcept
3067 {
3068 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep))
3069 return false;
3070 if (!buf.canAppend_(15))
3071 return false;
3072 if (!buf.appendRawText_("T="))
3073 return false;
3074 return appendElapsedTime(buf, log.threadTimeMs_);
3075 }
3076
3077 /// \brief Appends the time delta since the thread's previous log record.
3078 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3079 bool appendThreadDelta(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep) noexcept
3080 {
3081 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep))
3082 return false;
3083 if (!buf.canAppend_(8))
3084 return false;
3085 if (!buf.appendRawText_("d="))
3086 return false;
3087
3088 const std::int64_t ns = log.threadDeltaNs_;
3089 if (ns < 0) return buf.appendRawText_(invalidTimeDelta);
3090 if (ns == 0) return buf.appendRawText_("[INIT]");
3091
3092 std::int64_t val = 0;
3093 char suffix = 'h';
3094
3095 for (const UnitInfo& unit : deltaUnits) {
3096 const std::int64_t half = unit.scaleNs_ / 2;
3097 const std::int64_t rounded = (ns > std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() - half)
3098 ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()
3099 : ns + half;
3100 val = rounded / unit.scaleNs_;
3101 suffix = unit.suffix_;
3102
3103 if (val < 10000) break;
3104 }
3105
3106 // Ensures we never exceed "999.9" even for huge hours, preventing garbage chars.
3107 if (val > 9999) val = 9999;
3108
3109 const std::int64_t iPart = val / 10;
3110 const std::int64_t fPart = val % 10;
3111
3112 bool ok = buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + ((iPart / 100) % 10)));
3113 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + ((iPart / 10) % 10)));
3114 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + (iPart % 10)));
3115 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_('.');
3116 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(static_cast<char>('0' + fPart));
3117 ok = ok && buf.appendRawChar_(suffix);
3118
3119 return ok;
3120 }
3121
3122 /// \brief Appends cached logging-category text.
3123 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3124 bool appendCategory(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep) noexcept
3125 {
3126 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep)) return false;
3127 const auto [beg, len] = LeakedState::Inst_().categoryCache_.data_(log.category_);
3128 if (len > 0) return buf.appendRawTextFast_(beg, len);
3129 return buf.appendRawChar_('?'); // append '?' for available cache
3130 }
3131
3132 /// \brief Appends cached file and line text.
3133 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3134 bool appendFileLine(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep) noexcept
3135 {
3136 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep)) return false;
3137 const auto [beg, len] = LeakedState::Inst_().fileLineCache_.data_(log.fileLine_);
3138 if (len > 0) return buf.appendRawTextFast_(beg, len);
3139 return buf.appendRawChar_('?'); // append '?' for available cache
3140 }
3141
3142 /// \brief Appends cached normalized function text.
3143 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3144 bool appendFunction(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep) noexcept
3145 {
3146 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep)) return false;
3147 const auto [beg, len] = LeakedState::Inst_().functionCache_.data_(log.function_);
3148 if (len > 0) return buf.appendRawTextFast_(beg, len);
3149 return buf.appendRawChar_('?'); // append '?' for available cache
3150 }
3151
3152 /// \brief Appends the sanitized message and optional late-record marker.
3153 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3154 bool appendMessage(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool pipeSep, bool late = false) noexcept
3155 {
3156 if (!buf.appendDelimiter_(pipeSep))
3157 return false;
3158
3159 // Late messages i.e. ones that arrive after shutdown mode is set to true
3160 // have a "[LATE]" marker and are always sent to important log process.
3161 if (late) {
3162 if (!buf.appendRawText_("[LATE] "))
3163 return false;
3164 }
3165
3166 // Capture buffer position to later detect if no characters were added.
3167 const size_t prvPos = buf.size_();
3168
3169 const qsizetype qLen = log.message_.size();
3170 if (qLen <= 0) return buf.appendRawChar_('?'); // append '?' when no text is available
3171 const ushort* txt = log.message_.utf16();
3172 const size_t len = static_cast<size_t>(qLen);
3173 const size_t count = (len < 4096u) ? len : 4096u;
3174 for (size_t ii = 0; ii < count; ++ii) {
3175 if (!buf.appendChar_(static_cast<wchar_t>(txt[ii])))
3176 return false;
3177 }
3178
3179 // If current position is same as previous position then it means
3180 // no characters were added, we append '?' in that case.
3181 if (buf.size_() == prvPos)
3182 return buf.appendRawChar_('?');
3183 return true;
3184 }
3185
3186 /// \brief Formats the fixed important-log record sent to the helper process.
3187 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3188 bool bridgeLog(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, bool late = false) noexcept
3189 {
3190 bool ok = appendDateTime(buf, log, true);
3191 ok = ok && appendSequence(buf, log, true);
3192 ok = ok && appendLevel(buf, log, true);
3193 ok = ok && appendThreadIndex(buf, log, true);
3194 ok = ok && appendThreadId(buf, log, true);
3195 ok = ok && appendAppTime(buf, log, true);
3196 ok = ok && appendThreadTime(buf, log, true);
3197 ok = ok && appendThreadDelta(buf, log, true);
3198 ok = ok && appendCategory(buf, log, true);
3199 ok = ok && appendFileLine(buf, log, true);
3200 ok = ok && appendFunction(buf, log, true);
3201 ok = ok && appendMessage(buf, log, true, late);
3202 buf.finalizeAsNewLine_();
3203 return ok;
3204 }
3205
3206 /// \brief Formats one record using the active normal or display field layout.
3207 template <size_t LineSize, size_t NumLines>
3208 bool normalLog(TextBuffer<LineSize, NumLines>& buf, const OneLog& log, const layout::FieldArray& fieldArray,
3209 DateTimeCache& dateTimeCache, bool pipeSep) noexcept
3210 {
3211 bool ok = true;
3212 for (const std::uint8_t fieldId : fieldArray) {
3213 if (fieldId >= layout::maxFields) continue;
3214 const Field field = static_cast<Field>(fieldId);
3215 switch (field) {
3216 case Field::DateTime:
3217 ok = appendDateTime(buf, log, pipeSep, &dateTimeCache);
3218 break;
3219 case Field::Sequence:
3220 ok = appendSequence(buf, log, pipeSep);
3221 break;
3222 case Field::Level:
3223 ok = appendLevel(buf, log, pipeSep);
3224 break;
3225 case Field::ThreadIndex:
3226 ok = appendThreadIndex(buf, log, pipeSep);
3227 break;
3228 case Field::ThreadId:
3229 ok = appendThreadId(buf, log, pipeSep);
3230 break;
3231 case Field::AppTime:
3232 ok = appendAppTime(buf, log, pipeSep);
3233 break;
3234 case Field::ThreadTime:
3235 ok = appendThreadTime(buf, log, pipeSep);
3236 break;
3237 case Field::ThreadDelta:
3238 ok = appendThreadDelta(buf, log, pipeSep);
3239 break;
3240 case Field::Category:
3241 ok = appendCategory(buf, log, pipeSep);
3242 break;
3243 case Field::FileLine:
3244 ok = appendFileLine(buf, log, pipeSep);
3245 break;
3246 case Field::Function:
3247 ok = appendFunction(buf, log, pipeSep);
3248 break;
3249 }
3250 if (!ok) break;
3251 }
3252
3253 // Message always has the " | " before it to separate it from other texts,
3254 // that is why we pipeSep as true here always.
3255 if (ok) ok = appendMessage(buf, log, true);
3256
3257 buf.finalizeAsNewLine_();
3258 return ok;
3259 }
3260 }
3261
3262 /**
3263 * \brief Detects, opens, configures, and closes Windows console output.
3264 * \details
3265 * A console attached at startup is treated as permanent. A temporary console can
3266 * be allocated and released at runtime without affecting debugger output.
3267 */
3268 namespace console
3269 {
3270 /// \brief Checks whether a console was attached during initialization.
3271 bool isPermanent()
3272 {
3273 return LeakedState::Inst_().permConsole_ != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
3274 }
3275
3276 /// \brief Checks whether a console window is currently attached.
3277 bool isOpen()
3278 {
3279 return ::GetConsoleWindow() != nullptr;
3280 }
3281
3282 /// \brief Returns the active console output handle when one is available.
3283 HANDLE handle()
3284 {
3285 // Permanent console uses the dedicated CONOUT$ handle, independently
3286 // of redirected stdout or stderr.
3287 if (const HANDLE permConsole = LeakedState::Inst_().permConsole_;
3288 permConsole != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
3289 return permConsole;
3290
3291 // Temporary console uses the standard error handle established by
3292 // AllocConsole().
3293 const HANDLE console = ::GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE);
3294 if (console != nullptr && console != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
3295 DWORD outMode = 0;
3296 // if console is a redirect, this check will fail
3297 if (::GetConsoleMode(console, &outMode) != 0)
3298 return console;
3299 }
3300 return nullptr;
3301 }
3302
3303 /// \brief Allocates and configures a temporary console when necessary.
3304 bool open()
3305 {
3306 // If any console is already attached, do not allocate another.
3307 // This covers both permanent console and already-open temporary console.
3308 if (::GetConsoleWindow() != nullptr)
3309 return true;
3310
3311 if (!::AllocConsole())
3312 return false;
3313
3314 // Configure OUTPUT Handle (STD_ERROR_HANDLE) ----
3315
3316 // This handles text wrapping and newline processing.
3317 const HANDLE hOut = ::GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE);
3318 if (hOut == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE || hOut == nullptr) {
3319 ::FreeConsole();
3320 return false;
3321 }
3322
3323 // If h is a file redirect, GetConsoleMode fails.
3324 // We want to fail in that case because WriteConsoleW won't work on files.
3325 DWORD outMode = 0;
3326 if (::GetConsoleMode(hOut, &outMode) == 0) {
3327 // Not a real console
3328 ::FreeConsole();
3329 return false;
3330 }
3331
3332 // Set desired properties
3333 const DWORD desiredOutMode = outMode | ENABLE_PROCESSED_OUTPUT | ENABLE_WRAP_AT_EOL_OUTPUT;
3334 if (outMode != desiredOutMode)
3335 ::SetConsoleMode(hOut, desiredOutMode);
3336
3337 // Configure INPUT Handle (STD_INPUT_HANDLE) ----
3338
3339 // This handles Mouse Clicks and Quick Edit Mode.
3340 const HANDLE hIn = ::GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE);
3341 if (hIn != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && hIn != nullptr) {
3342 DWORD inMode = 0;
3343 if (::GetConsoleMode(hIn, &inMode)) {
3344 // ENABLE_EXTENDED_FLAGS is required to change Quick Edit settings
3345 DWORD desiredInMode = inMode | ENABLE_EXTENDED_FLAGS;
3346
3347 // DISABLE Quick Edit Mode (stops mouse clicks from pausing execution)
3348 desiredInMode &= ~ENABLE_QUICK_EDIT_MODE;
3349 // DISABLE Insert Mode
3350 desiredInMode &= ~ENABLE_INSERT_MODE;
3351 // DISABLE Mouse Input (Prevents accidental processing overhead)
3352 desiredInMode &= ~ENABLE_MOUSE_INPUT;
3353
3354 if (inMode != desiredInMode)
3355 ::SetConsoleMode(hIn, desiredInMode);
3356 }
3357 }
3358
3359 // Configure Console Window ----
3360
3361 // Set the console title
3362 QString title{QString(npi::app::name).append(" Console")};
3363 ::SetConsoleTitleW(reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(title.utf16()));
3364
3365 // Disable the Close Button (Prevent user from killing app via Console X)
3366 const HWND consoleWindow = ::GetConsoleWindow();
3367 if (consoleWindow != nullptr) {
3368 const HMENU hMenu = ::GetSystemMenu(consoleWindow, FALSE);
3369 if (hMenu != nullptr && ::DeleteMenu(hMenu, SC_CLOSE, MF_BYCOMMAND))
3370 ::DrawMenuBar(consoleWindow);
3371 }
3372
3373 // Redirect standard C streams to the new console
3374 // This allows 3rd party libs using printf/std::cout to work.
3375 FILE* f = nullptr;
3376 if (::freopen_s(&f, "CONOUT$", "w", stdout) == 0)
3377 (void)std::setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
3378
3379 if (::freopen_s(&f, "CONOUT$", "w", stderr) == 0)
3380 (void)std::setvbuf(stderr, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
3381
3382 return true;
3383 }
3384
3385 /// \brief Releases the temporary console while preserving a permanent console.
3386 void close()
3387 {
3388 // Never detach the permanent console.
3389 if (isPermanent())
3390 return;
3391
3392 // Redirect CRT streams to NUL for safety
3393 FILE* dummy;
3394 (void)::freopen_s(&dummy, "NUL", "w", stdout);
3395 (void)::freopen_s(&dummy, "NUL", "w", stderr);
3396
3397 if (const HWND hwnd = ::GetConsoleWindow(); hwnd != nullptr)
3398 ::GetSystemMenu(hwnd, TRUE); // Revert menu to default state
3399
3400 // Free the Console Window
3401 ::FreeConsole();
3402 }
3403 }
3404
3405 /**
3406 * \brief Owns asynchronous file and display processing and directory cleanup.
3407 * \details
3408 * The file worker is the sole producer of the display queue. During shutdown it
3409 * is therefore stopped and joined before the display worker, allowing all final
3410 * records to be forwarded and drained deterministically.
3411 */
3412 namespace workers
3413 {
3414 constexpr size_t dequeueBatchSize = 128u; ///< Number of logs to dequeue in one batch
3415 constexpr size_t batchFormatLineSize = 2048u; ///< Maximum size of a single formatted line in batch processing
3416 constexpr size_t maxDisplayLinesPerSec = 4096u; ///< Maximum number of lines to display per second
3417 constexpr std::chrono::milliseconds minSyncInterval{500}; ///< Minimum interval for syncing data with LeakedState
3418
3419 constexpr size_t finalFileDrainIdleLoopCount = 10u;
3420 ///< Number of idle loop counts before file worker quits after shutdown is initiated.
3421 constexpr size_t finalDispDrainIdleLoopCount = 3u;
3422 ///< Number of idle loop counts before display worker quits after shutdown is initiated.
3423 constexpr std::chrono::milliseconds finalDrainIdleLoopSleep{50};
3424 ///< Sleep time for file and display threads in between final drain after shutdown is initiated.
3425
3426 constexpr size_t normalMaxIdleLoopCount = 3u;
3427 ///< Maximum idle loop before worker goes to permanent sleep to be woken up only by its wakeup_ variable.
3428 constexpr std::chrono::milliseconds normalIdleLoopSleep{10}; ///< Sleep time between idle loops.
3429
3430 static_assert((dequeueBatchSize * batchFormatLineSize) <= std::numeric_limits<DWORD>::max());
3431
3432 /// \brief Creates an internal logging-system record to be appended to file queue without re-entering Qt logging.
3433 OneLog syntheticLog(QtMsgType lvl, const QString& msg)
3434 {
3435 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
3436
3437 const auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
3438 const qint64 nowNs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
3439 nowTp - leaked.startTp_).count();
3440
3441 const std::uint32_t appTimeMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
3442 std::min<qint64>(nowNs / 1000000, std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()));
3443
3444 return {
3445 .level_ = OneLog::LevelCast_(lvl),
3446 .category_ = 0,
3447 .threadIdx_ = 0,
3448 .fileLine_ = 0,
3449 .function_ = 0,
3450 .threadId_ = ::GetCurrentThreadId(),
3451 .sequence_ = leaked.run_.logSequence_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed),
3452 .appTimeMs_ = appTimeMs,
3453 .threadTimeMs_ = 0,
3454 .threadDeltaNs_ = -1,
3455 .dateTime_ = std::chrono::system_clock::now(),
3456 .message_ = QStringLiteral("----- %1 -----").arg(msg)
3457 };
3458 }
3459
3460 /// \brief Signals a worker that queued work or a state change is available.
3461 void wakeup(LeakedState::Worker& worker) noexcept
3462 {
3463 if (!worker.wakeup_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
3464 worker.wakeup_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
3465 worker.wakeup_.notify_one();
3466 }
3467 }
3468
3469 /// \brief Stops and joins workers in producer-before-consumer order.
3470 void shutdown()
3471 {
3472 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
3473 std::call_once(leaked.run_.workersShutdownInitiated_, [&leaked]
3474 {
3475 // Since only file worker forwards logs to display worker, we first
3476 // join the file worker and then the display worker.
3477
3478 if (leaked.file_.worker_.thread_.joinable()) {
3479 leaked.file_.worker_.thread_.request_stop();
3480 leaked.file_.worker_.thread_.join();
3481 }
3482
3483 if (leaked.disp_.worker_.thread_.joinable()) {
3484 leaked.disp_.worker_.thread_.request_stop();
3485
3486 // do not wait forever for display blocked in WriteConsoleA
3487 DWORD result = ::WaitForSingleObject(leaked.disp_.worker_.thread_.native_handle(), 2500);
3488
3489 if (result == WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
3490 // wait returned normally i.e. the thread could be joined.
3491 leaked.disp_.worker_.thread_.join();
3492 }
3493 else if (result == WAIT_TIMEOUT) {
3494 // wait returned after timeout, the thread is possibly blocked.
3495
3496 const QString titleStr{npi::app::name};
3497 const wchar_t* title = reinterpret_cast<const wchar_t*>(titleStr.utf16());
3498 const wchar_t* message =
3499 L"The log display is blocked, possibly because text is currently selected in the console, "
3500 L"and is preventing the application from shutting down.\n\n"
3501 L"Clearing the console selection, if any, may allow the application to close normally.\n\n"
3502 L"Would you like to continue shutting down the application without waiting for the log display?";
3503 int val = ::MessageBoxW(nullptr, message, title,
3504 MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION | MB_TOPMOST | MB_SETFOREGROUND);
3505
3506 if (val == IDNO && leaked.disp_.worker_.thread_.joinable()) {
3507 // user wants to wait till display thread is done
3508 leaked.disp_.worker_.thread_.join();
3509 }
3510 }
3511 }
3512 });
3513 }
3514
3515 /// \brief Discards remaining queued logs and marks the worker inactive.
3516 void cleanup(LeakedState::Worker& worker)
3517 {
3518 OneLog dummy;
3519 moodycamel::ConsumerToken token{worker.queue_};
3520 while (worker.queue_.try_dequeue(token, dummy)) {}
3521
3522 worker.active_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
3523 }
3524
3525 /// \brief Starts the optional display worker if it is currently inactive.
3526 /// \details This worker consumes only records forwarded by the file worker and
3527 /// exits when neither a console nor a debugger remains available.
3528 bool dispWorkerStart()
3529 {
3530 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
3531 LeakedState::DispWorker& self = leaked.disp_;
3532 LeakedState::Worker& worker = self.worker_;
3533
3534 // Only start if not already started, it is indicated by active flag.
3535 if (bool expected = false; !worker.active_.compare_exchange_strong(expected, true, std::memory_order_acq_rel))
3536 return true;
3537
3538 try {
3539 worker.thread_ = std::jthread([&leaked, &self, &worker](std::stop_token stopToken)
3540 {
3541 self.failed_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
3542
3543 // Cleanup guard to make sure queue is drained and active set false even in case
3544 // of an abrupt exit.
3545 const auto cleanupGuard = qScopeGuard([&worker]() noexcept { cleanup(worker); });
3546
3547 // This called is executed when stop is requested, it wakes up the worker
3548 // so that it can continue with final drain loops and exit.
3549 std::stop_callback callback{
3550 stopToken, [&worker]() noexcept
3551 {
3552 worker.wakeup_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
3553 worker.wakeup_.notify_one();
3554 }
3555 };
3556
3557 try {
3558 const DWORD selfThreadId = ::GetCurrentThreadId();
3559
3560 moodycamel::ConsumerToken cToken{worker.queue_};
3561 moodycamel::ProducerToken pFileToken{leaked.file_.worker_.queue_};
3562 // for enqueuing logs to file workers queue.
3563
3564 auto startupLog = syntheticLog(QtInfoMsg, QStringLiteral("Logging System: Display thread started."));
3565 if (leaked.file_.worker_.queue_.enqueue(pFileToken, std::move(startupLog)))
3566 wakeup(leaked.file_.worker_);
3567 else
3568 leaked.file_.droppedLogs_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
3569
3570 OneLog batch[dequeueBatchSize];
3571
3572 // Allocate the text buffer on the heap to avoid excessive stack usage.
3573 auto bufPtr = std::make_unique<TextBuffer<batchFormatLineSize, dequeueBatchSize>>();
3574 auto& buf = *bufPtr;
3575
3576 layout::FieldArray fields;
3577 layout::unpackFields(worker.packedFields_, fields);
3578
3579 format::DateTimeCache dateTimeCache;
3580
3581 auto syncTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point::min();
3582
3583 // Display rate limiting is independent of file throughput and resets once per second.
3584 auto lineTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
3585
3586 bool showWarnLog{true};
3587 bool showInfoLog{true};
3588 bool showDbugLog{true};
3589 bool coloredConsole{true};
3590
3591 size_t totalCount = 0u;
3592 size_t shownLines = 0u;
3593 size_t suppressed = 0u;
3594 size_t formatIssues = 0u;
3595
3596 bool stopRequested{false};
3597 size_t idleCount = 0u;
3598
3599 auto resetRateLimitIfNeeded = [&]()
3600 {
3601 const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
3602 if (now < lineTp + std::chrono::seconds(1))
3603 return;
3604 shownLines = 0u;
3605 lineTp = now;
3606 };
3607
3608 auto suppressedMsg = [&]() -> QString
3609 {
3610 if (suppressed > 0)
3611 return QStringLiteral(
3612 "---------------- Suppressed %1 display log line(s) due to excessive log rate ----------------\r\n")
3613.
3614 arg(suppressed);
3615 return {};
3616 };
3617
3618 auto formatIssueMsg = [&]() -> QString
3619 {
3620 if (formatIssues > 0)
3621 return QStringLiteral("---------------- Failed to format %1 log line(s) properly ----------------\r\n").
3622 arg(formatIssues);
3623 return {};
3624 };
3625
3626 const auto formatBatch = [&](size_t count)
3627 {
3628 buf.clear_();
3629 for (size_t ii = 0; ii < count; ++ii) {
3630 if (batch[ii].level_ == 2 && !showWarnLog)
3631 continue;
3632 if (batch[ii].level_ == 1 && !showInfoLog)
3633 continue;
3634 if (batch[ii].level_ == 0 && !showDbugLog)
3635 continue;
3636
3637 if (((batch[ii].level_ == 1) || (batch[ii].level_ == 0))
3638 && shownLines >= maxDisplayLinesPerSec) {
3639 ++suppressed;
3640 continue;
3641 }
3642
3643 ++shownLines;
3644 if (!format::normalLog(buf, batch[ii], fields, dateTimeCache, false)) {
3645 if (batch[ii].threadId_ != selfThreadId)
3646 ++formatIssues;
3647 }
3648 }
3649 };
3650
3651 while (true) {
3652 if (const auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); nowTp >= syncTp + minSyncInterval) {
3653 syncTp = nowTp;
3654 layout::unpackFields(worker.packedFields_, fields);
3655 const auto cfg = leaked.cfg_.readAccess_();
3656 showWarnLog = cfg->showWarnLog_;
3657 showInfoLog = cfg->showInfoLog_;
3658 showDbugLog = cfg->showDbugLog_;
3659 coloredConsole = cfg->coloredConsole_;
3660 }
3661
3662 totalCount = 0u;
3663 suppressed = 0u;
3664 formatIssues = 0u;
3665
3666 if (auto hConsole = console::handle(); hConsole != nullptr) {
3667 CONSOLE_SCREEN_BUFFER_INFO info{};
3668 if (coloredConsole && ::GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo(hConsole, &info)) {
3669 const WORD oldAttr = info.wAttributes;
3670 const WORD bgAttr = oldAttr & 0xF0;
3671 WORD currentAttr = oldAttr;
3672
3673 const auto attrGuard = qScopeGuard([&]
3674 {
3675 if (currentAttr != oldAttr)
3676 ::SetConsoleTextAttribute(hConsole, oldAttr);
3677 });
3678
3679 auto setAttr = [&](WORD attr)
3680 {
3681 if (attr == currentAttr)
3682 return;
3683 if (::SetConsoleTextAttribute(hConsole, attr))
3684 currentAttr = attr;
3685 };
3686
3687 WORD nextAttr = oldAttr;
3688
3689 while (const size_t count = worker.queue_.try_dequeue_bulk(cToken, batch, dequeueBatchSize)) {
3690 resetRateLimitIfNeeded();
3691 totalCount += count;
3692
3693 // Since this batch is already dequeued, in case WriteConsoleA fails we
3694 // to output to debugger if attached.
3695 bool writeFailed{false};
3696
3697 for (size_t ii = 0; ii < count; ++ii) {
3698 if (batch[ii].level_ == 2 && !showWarnLog)
3699 continue;
3700 if (batch[ii].level_ == 1 && !showInfoLog)
3701 continue;
3702 if (batch[ii].level_ == 0 && !showDbugLog)
3703 continue;
3704
3705 if (((batch[ii].level_ == 1) || (batch[ii].level_ == 0))
3706 && shownLines >= maxDisplayLinesPerSec) {
3707 ++suppressed;
3708 continue;
3709 }
3710
3711 ++shownLines;
3712 buf.clear_();
3713 if (!format::normalLog(buf, batch[ii], fields, dateTimeCache, false)) {
3714 if (batch[ii].threadId_ != selfThreadId)
3715 ++formatIssues;
3716 }
3717
3718 if (buf.size_() == 0u)
3719 continue;
3720
3721 // write to WriteConsoleA failed in previous iteration, reroute
3722 // to debugger is possible.
3723 if (writeFailed) {
3724 if (::IsDebuggerPresent())
3725 ::OutputDebugStringA(buf.data_());
3726 continue;
3727 }
3728
3729 switch (batch[ii].level_) {
3730 case 0:
3731 nextAttr = bgAttr | FOREGROUND_GREEN;
3732 break;
3733
3734 case 1:
3735 nextAttr = bgAttr | FOREGROUND_RED | FOREGROUND_GREEN | FOREGROUND_BLUE;
3736 break;
3737
3738 case 2:
3739 nextAttr = bgAttr | FOREGROUND_RED | FOREGROUND_GREEN;
3740 break;
3741
3742 case 3:
3743 case 4:
3744 nextAttr = bgAttr | FOREGROUND_RED | FOREGROUND_INTENSITY;
3745 break;
3746
3747 default: nextAttr = currentAttr;
3748 break;
3749 }
3750
3751 setAttr(nextAttr);
3752
3753 DWORD written = 0;
3754 if (!::WriteConsoleA(hConsole, buf.data_(), static_cast<DWORD>(buf.size_()), &written, nullptr)) {
3755 // write failed, set the flag as true and reroute to debugger is possible
3756 writeFailed = true;
3757 if (::IsDebuggerPresent())
3758 ::OutputDebugStringA(buf.data_());
3759 else
3760 break;
3761 }
3762 }
3763
3764 // Do not dequeue another batch if WriteConsoleA failed or total count has
3765 // exceeded the worker queue size. The entire loop starting with while(true)
3766 // will run again without delay and the rest of the data will be processed.
3767 if (writeFailed || totalCount >= workerQueueSize)
3768 break;
3769 }
3770 }
3771 else {
3772 while (const size_t count = worker.queue_.try_dequeue_bulk(cToken, batch, dequeueBatchSize)) {
3773 resetRateLimitIfNeeded();
3774 totalCount += count;
3775
3776 formatBatch(count);
3777
3778 if (buf.size_() > 0u) {
3779 DWORD written = 0;
3780 if (!::WriteConsoleA(hConsole, buf.data_(), static_cast<DWORD>(buf.size_()), &written, nullptr)) {
3781 if (::IsDebuggerPresent())
3782 ::OutputDebugStringA(buf.data_());
3783 break;
3784 }
3785 }
3786
3787 if (totalCount >= workerQueueSize)
3788 break;
3789 }
3790 }
3791
3792 if (const QString msg = suppressedMsg(); !msg.isEmpty()) {
3793 DWORD written = 0;
3794 if (!::WriteConsoleW(hConsole, msg.utf16(), static_cast<DWORD>(msg.length()), &written, nullptr)) {
3795 if (::IsDebuggerPresent())
3796 ::OutputDebugStringW(reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(msg.utf16()));
3797 }
3798 }
3799
3800 if (const QString msg = formatIssueMsg(); !msg.isEmpty()) {
3801 DWORD written = 0;
3802 if (!::WriteConsoleW(hConsole, msg.utf16(), static_cast<DWORD>(msg.length()), &written, nullptr)) {
3803 if (::IsDebuggerPresent())
3804 ::OutputDebugStringW(reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(msg.utf16()));
3805 }
3806 }
3807 }
3808 else if (::IsDebuggerPresent()) {
3809 while (const size_t count = worker.queue_.try_dequeue_bulk(cToken, batch, dequeueBatchSize)) {
3810 resetRateLimitIfNeeded();
3811 totalCount += count;
3812
3813 formatBatch(count);
3814
3815 if (buf.size_() > 0u)
3816 ::OutputDebugStringA(buf.data_());
3817
3818 if (totalCount >= workerQueueSize)
3819 break;
3820 }
3821
3822 if (const QString msg = suppressedMsg(); !msg.isEmpty())
3823 ::OutputDebugStringW(reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(msg.utf16()));
3824
3825 if (const QString msg = formatIssueMsg(); !msg.isEmpty())
3826 ::OutputDebugStringW(reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(msg.utf16()));
3827 }
3828 else {
3829 // Enqueue exit log only when no console or debugger found, this is
3830 // the correct exit condition.
3831 if (!stopToken.stop_requested()) {
3832 auto exitLog = syntheticLog(
3833 QtInfoMsg, QStringLiteral("Logging System: Display thread exiting, no console or debugger found."));
3834 if (leaked.file_.worker_.queue_.enqueue(pFileToken, std::move(exitLog)))
3835 wakeup(leaked.file_.worker_);
3836 else
3837 leaked.file_.droppedLogs_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
3838 }
3839 break;
3840 }
3841
3842 if (!stopRequested && stopToken.stop_requested()) {
3843 // No need for shutdown log here because file worker has already exited.
3844 stopRequested = true;
3845 idleCount = 0u;
3846 continue;
3847 }
3848
3849 if (totalCount > 0u) {
3850 idleCount = 0u;
3851 continue;
3852 }
3853
3854 if (stopRequested) {
3855 ++idleCount;
3856 if (idleCount > finalDispDrainIdleLoopCount)
3857 break;
3858 std::this_thread::sleep_for(finalDrainIdleLoopSleep);
3859 }
3860 else {
3861 ++idleCount;
3862 if (idleCount < normalMaxIdleLoopCount) {
3863 std::this_thread::sleep_for(normalIdleLoopSleep);
3864 }
3865 else if (idleCount == normalMaxIdleLoopCount) {
3866 worker.wakeup_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
3867 }
3868 else {
3869 worker.wakeup_.wait(false, std::memory_order_acquire);
3870 idleCount = 0u;
3871 }
3872 }
3873 }
3874 }
3875 catch (const std::exception& e) {
3876 self.failed_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
3877
3878 // cleanup will be called by the qScopeGuard when the thread function exits.
3879
3880 const QString msg = QStringLiteral(
3881 "Logging System:\n"
3882 "Display thread failed while running.\n\n"
3883 "Error: %1").arg(QString::fromLocal8Bit(e.what()));
3884
3885 // Safe to log here: the worker has left its processing loop and will not restart automatically.
3886 npiCrit << msg;
3887
3888 // Show out-of-process warning message box
3889 npi::app::winWarnMsgExe(msg);
3890 }
3891 catch (...) {
3892 self.failed_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
3893
3894 // cleanup will be called by the qScopeGuard when the thread function exits.
3895
3896 const char* msg =
3897 "Logging System:\n"
3898 "Display thread failed while running.\n\n"
3899 "Error: Unknown exception";
3900
3901 // Safe to log here: the worker has left its processing loop and will not restart automatically.
3902 npiCrit << msg;
3903
3904 // Show out-of-process warning message box
3905 npi::app::winWarnMsgExe(msg);
3906 }
3907 });
3908 }
3909 catch (const std::system_error& e) {
3910 self.failed_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
3911
3912 cleanup(worker);
3913
3914 const QString msg = QStringLiteral(
3915 "Logging System:\n"
3916 "Display thread failed to start.\n\n"
3917 "Error: %1 (code %2)")
3918 .arg(QString::fromLocal8Bit(e.what()))
3919 .arg(e.code().value());
3920
3921 // Safe to log here: the worker thread was not started.
3922 npiCrit << msg;
3923
3924 // Show out-of-process warning message box
3925 npi::app::winWarnMsgExe(msg);
3926
3927 return false;
3928 }
3929 catch (...) {
3930 self.failed_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
3931
3932 cleanup(worker);
3933
3934 const char* msg =
3935 "Logging System:\n"
3936 "Display thread failed to start.\n\n"
3937 "Error: Unknown exception";
3938
3939 // Safe to log here: the worker thread was not started.
3940 npiCrit << msg;
3941
3942 // Show out-of-process warning message box
3943 npi::app::winWarnMsgExe(msg);
3944
3945 return false;
3946 }
3947
3948 return true;
3949 }

3951 /// \brief Starts the primary file worker if it is currently inactive.
3952 /// \details The worker owns normal-file output, forwards selected records
3953 /// to the display queue, and coordinates helper replacement during directory changes.
3954 void fileWorkerStart()
3955 {
3956 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
3957 LeakedState::FileWorker& self = leaked.file_;
3958 LeakedState::Worker& worker = self.worker_;
3959
3960 // Only start if not already started, it is indicated by active flag.
3961 if (bool expected = false; !worker.active_.compare_exchange_strong(expected, true, std::memory_order_acq_rel))
3962 return;
3963
3964 try {
3965 worker.thread_ = std::jthread([&leaked, &self, &worker](std::stop_token stopToken)
3966 {
3967 // Cleanup guard to make sure queue is drained and active set false even in case
3968 // of an abrupt exit.
3969 const auto cleanupGuard = qScopeGuard([&worker]() noexcept { cleanup(worker); });
3970
3971 // This called is executed when stop is requested, it wakes up the worker
3972 // so that it can continue with final drain loops and exit.
3973 std::stop_callback callback{
3974 stopToken, [&worker]() noexcept
3975 {
3976 worker.wakeup_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
3977 worker.wakeup_.notify_one();
3978 }
3979 };
3980
3981 try {
3982 QString fileFullPath;
3983 QFile file;
3984
3985 const auto checkFile = [&]()
3986 {
3987 const QString nowPath = self.fileFullPath_.read_();
3988 if (nowPath == fileFullPath) return;
3989
3990 if (file.isOpen()) file.close();
3991 fileFullPath = nowPath;
3992 file.setFileName(fileFullPath);
3993
3994 if (!file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly)) {
3995 const QString msg = QStringLiteral(
3996 "Logging System Fatal Error:\n"
3997 "File writer thread failed to open the log file for writing.\n\n"
3998 "File: %1\n\n"
3999 "The application cannot continue safely without logging support and will now exit.\n\n"
4000 "Error: %2\n\n")
4001 .arg(QDir::cleanPath(file.fileName()), file.errorString());
4002
4003 // logs, shows out-of-process message box, terminates the process
4004 npiFatl << msg;
4005
4006 // hard fallback if fatal handling unexpectedly returns
4007 std::abort();
4008 }
4009
4010 self.fileReady_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
4011 self.fileReady_.notify_all();
4012 };
4013
4014 const DWORD selfThreadId = ::GetCurrentThreadId();
4015
4016 moodycamel::ConsumerToken cToken{worker.queue_};
4017 moodycamel::ProducerToken pToken{worker.queue_};
4018 moodycamel::ProducerToken pDispToken{leaked.disp_.worker_.queue_};
4019 moodycamel::ConsumerToken cDispToken{leaked.disp_.worker_.queue_};
4020
4021 auto startupLog = syntheticLog(QtInfoMsg, QStringLiteral("Logging System: File writer thread started."));
4022 if (!worker.queue_.enqueue(pToken, std::move(startupLog)))
4023 self.droppedLogs_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
4024
4025 layout::FieldArray fields;
4026 layout::unpackFields(worker.packedFields_, fields);
4027
4028 format::DateTimeCache dateTimeCache;
4029
4030 OneLog batch[dequeueBatchSize];
4031
4032 // Allocate the text buffers on the heap to avoid excessive stack usage.
4033 auto bufPtr = std::make_unique<TextBuffer<batchFormatLineSize, dequeueBatchSize>>();
4034 auto& buf = *bufPtr;
4035 auto warnBufPtr = std::make_unique<TextBuffer<batchFormatLineSize, dequeueBatchSize>>();
4036 auto& warnBuf = *warnBufPtr;
4037
4038 bool warnIsImp{false};
4039 bool dispState{false};
4040 auto syncTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point::min();
4041
4042 bool stopRequested{false};
4043 size_t idleCount = 0u;
4044 while (true) {
4045 checkFile();
4046
4047 if (const auto nowSyncTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); nowSyncTp >= syncTp + minSyncInterval) {
4048 syncTp = nowSyncTp;
4049
4050 const auto nowDispState = (console::handle() != nullptr || ::IsDebuggerPresent())
4051 && !leaked.disp_.failed_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)
4052 && !leaked.disp_.mute_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
4053
4054 if (nowDispState && !leaked.disp_.worker_.active_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
4055 dispWorkerStart();
4056 }
4057 else if (!nowDispState && dispState) {
4058 // empty display queue if display is now disabled but was previously enabled
4059 OneLog dummy;
4060 while (leaked.disp_.worker_.queue_.try_dequeue(cDispToken, dummy)) {}
4061
4062 // In case it is waiting, we want it to exit, and in case of muted display this is harmless
4063 wakeup(leaked.disp_.worker_);
4064 }
4065
4066 dispState = nowDispState;
4067
4068 warnIsImp = leaked.cfg_.read_(&LeakedState::Config::warnIsImp_);
4069 layout::unpackFields(worker.packedFields_, fields);
4070 }
4071
4072 // dropped logs
4073 if (const std::uint32_t dropped = self.droppedLogs_.exchange(0u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
4074 dropped > 0) {
4075 auto droppedLog = syntheticLog(QtWarningMsg,
4076 QStringLiteral(
4077 "Logging System: %1 log line(s) dropped from reaching File writer queue.")
4078 .arg(dropped));
4079 if (!worker.queue_.enqueue(pToken, std::move(droppedLog)))
4080 self.droppedLogs_.fetch_add(dropped + 1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
4081 }
4082
4083 size_t totalCount = 0u;
4084 bool awaitingFlush{false};
4085 while (const size_t count = worker.queue_.try_dequeue_bulk(cToken, batch, dequeueBatchSize)) {
4086 totalCount += count;
4087
4088 buf.clear_();
4089 warnBuf.clear_();
4090
4091 size_t formatIssues{0};
4092 size_t warnFormatIssues{0};
4093
4094 bool reportFormatIssues{false};
4095 bool reportWarnFormatIssues{false};
4096 bool hasNonSelfLog{false};
4097
4098 for (size_t ii = 0; ii < count; ++ii) {
4099 const bool nonSelfLog = batch[ii].threadId_ != selfThreadId;
4100 if (nonSelfLog)
4101 hasNonSelfLog = true;
4102
4103 if (!format::normalLog(buf, batch[ii], fields, dateTimeCache, true)) {
4104 ++formatIssues;
4105 if (nonSelfLog)
4106 reportFormatIssues = true;
4107 }
4108
4109 if (warnIsImp && batch[ii].level_ == 2) {
4110 if (!format::bridgeLog(warnBuf, batch[ii], false)) {
4111 ++warnFormatIssues;
4112 if (nonSelfLog)
4113 reportWarnFormatIssues = true;
4114 }
4115 }
4116 }
4117
4118 // send to important log process
4119 if (warnBuf.size_() > 0)
4120 bridge::sendDataLocked(warnBuf.data_(), warnBuf.size_(), false);
4121
4122 if (formatIssues > 0 && reportFormatIssues) {
4123 auto formatLog = syntheticLog(QtWarningMsg,
4124 QStringLiteral(
4125 "Logging System: Failed to format %1 log line(s) from File writer queue.")
4126 .arg(formatIssues));
4127 if (!worker.queue_.enqueue(pToken, std::move(formatLog)))
4128 self.droppedLogs_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
4129 }
4130
4131 if (warnFormatIssues > 0 && reportWarnFormatIssues) {
4132 auto formatLog = syntheticLog(QtWarningMsg,
4133 QStringLiteral(
4134 "Logging System: Failed to format %1 warning-level forwarding log line(s) from File writer queue.")
4135 .arg(warnFormatIssues));
4136 if (!worker.queue_.enqueue(pToken, std::move(formatLog)))
4137 self.droppedLogs_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
4138 }
4139
4140 if (const size_t bufSize = buf.size_(); bufSize > 0) {
4141 awaitingFlush = true;
4142 size_t written = 0;
4143 int noProgressStreak = 0;
4144
4145 while (noProgressStreak < 3 && written < bufSize) {
4146 const qint64 want = static_cast<qint64>(bufSize - written);
4147 const qint64 n = file.write(buf.data_() + written, want);
4148
4149 if (n < 0) {
4150 const QString msg = QStringLiteral(
4151 "Logging System Fatal Error:\n"
4152 "File writer thread failed to write to the log file.\n\n"
4153 "File: %1\n\n"
4154 "The application cannot continue safely without logging support and will now exit.\n\n"
4155 "Error: %2\n\n")
4156 .arg(QDir::cleanPath(file.fileName()), file.errorString());
4157
4158 // logs, shows out-of-process message box, terminates the process
4159 npiFatl << msg;
4160
4161 // hard fallback if fatal handling unexpectedly returns
4162 std::abort();
4163 }
4164
4165 if (n > want) {
4166 const QString msg = QStringLiteral(
4167 "Logging System Fatal Error:\n"
4168 "File writer thread failed to write to the log file.\n\n"
4169 "File: %1\n\n"
4170 "Overflow/Corruption Error: file.write() returned %2 bytes, which exceeds the requested %3 bytes.\n\n"
4171 "The application cannot continue safely without logging support and will now exit.\n\n")
4172 .arg(QDir::cleanPath(file.fileName())).arg(n).arg(want);
4173
4174 // logs, shows out-of-process message box, terminates the process
4175 npiFatl << msg;
4176
4177 // hard fallback if fatal handling unexpectedly returns
4178 std::abort();
4179 }
4180
4181 if (n == 0) {
4182 ++noProgressStreak;
4183 std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds{1});
4184 continue;
4185 }
4186
4187 written += static_cast<size_t>(n);
4188 noProgressStreak = 0;
4189 }
4190
4191 if (written != bufSize) {
4192 const QString msg = QStringLiteral(
4193 "Logging System Fatal Error:\n"
4194 "File writer thread failed to write to the log file.\n\n"
4195 "File: %1\n\n"
4196 "The application cannot continue safely without logging support and will now exit.\n\n"
4197 "Error: 3 consecutive write attempts with no progress.\n\n")
4198 .arg(QDir::cleanPath(file.fileName()));
4199
4200 // logs, shows out-of-process message box, terminates the process
4201 npiFatl << msg;
4202
4203 // hard fallback if fatal handling unexpectedly returns
4204 std::abort();
4205 }
4206 }
4207
4208 if (dispState) {
4209 if (leaked.disp_.worker_.queue_.size_approx() + count <= workerQueueSize) {
4210 if (leaked.disp_.worker_.queue_.enqueue_bulk(pDispToken, std::make_move_iterator(batch), count)) {
4211 wakeup(leaked.disp_.worker_);
4212 }
4213 else if (hasNonSelfLog) {
4214 auto dispQueueLog = syntheticLog(QtWarningMsg,
4215 QStringLiteral(
4216 "Logging System: Failed to enqueue %1 log line(s) from File writer queue to display queue.")
4217 .arg(count));
4218 if (!worker.queue_.enqueue(pToken, std::move(dispQueueLog)))
4219 self.droppedLogs_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
4220 }
4221 }
4222 else if (hasNonSelfLog) {
4223 auto dispQueueLog = syntheticLog(QtWarningMsg,
4224 QStringLiteral(
4225 "Logging System: Display queue limit reached; skipped forwarding %1 log line(s) from the file worker.")
4226 .arg(count));
4227 if (!worker.queue_.enqueue(pToken, std::move(dispQueueLog)))
4228 self.droppedLogs_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
4229 }
4230 }
4231
4232 if (totalCount >= workerQueueSize)
4233 break;
4234 }
4235
4236 if (awaitingFlush) {
4237 bool flushOk = false;
4238 for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; ++attempt) {
4239 if (file.flush()) {
4240 flushOk = true;
4241 break;
4242 }
4243 std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds{1});
4244 }
4245
4246 if (!flushOk) {
4247 const QString msg = QStringLiteral("Logging System Fatal Error:\n"
4248 "File writer thread failed to flush the contents of the log file after 3 consecutive attempts.\n\n"
4249 "File: %1\n\n"
4250 "The application cannot continue safely without logging support and will now exit.\n\n"
4251 "Error: %2\n\n")
4252 .arg(QDir::cleanPath(file.fileName()), file.errorString());
4253
4254 // logs, shows out-of-process message box, terminates the process
4255 npiFatl << msg;
4256
4257 // hard fallback if fatal handling unexpectedly returns
4258 std::abort();
4259 }
4260 }
4261
4262 if (!stopRequested && stopToken.stop_requested()) {
4263 auto shutdownLog = syntheticLog(
4264 QtInfoMsg, QStringLiteral("Logging System: File writer thread shutdown initiated."));
4265 if (!worker.queue_.enqueue(pToken, std::move(shutdownLog)))
4266 self.droppedLogs_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
4267 stopRequested = true;
4268 idleCount = 0u;
4269 continue;
4270 }
4271
4272 if (totalCount > 0u) {
4273 idleCount = 0u;
4274 continue;
4275 }
4276
4277 if (stopRequested) {
4278 ++idleCount;
4279 if (idleCount > finalFileDrainIdleLoopCount)
4280 break;
4281 std::this_thread::sleep_for(finalDrainIdleLoopSleep);
4282 }
4283 else {
4284 ++idleCount;
4285 if (idleCount < normalMaxIdleLoopCount) {
4286 std::this_thread::sleep_for(normalIdleLoopSleep);
4287 }
4288 else if (idleCount == normalMaxIdleLoopCount) {
4289 worker.wakeup_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
4290 }
4291 else {
4292 worker.wakeup_.wait(false, std::memory_order_acquire);
4293 idleCount = 0u;
4294 }
4295 }
4296 }
4297 }
4298 catch (const std::exception& e) {
4299 const QString msg = QStringLiteral(
4300 "Logging System Fatal Error:\n"
4301 "File writer thread failed while running. "
4302 "The application cannot continue safely without logging support and will now exit.\n\n"
4303 "Error: %1").arg(QString::fromLocal8Bit(e.what()));
4304
4305 // logs, shows out-of-process message box, terminates the process
4306 npiFatl << msg;
4307
4308 // hard fallback if fatal handling unexpectedly returns
4309 std::abort();
4310 }
4311 catch (...) {
4312 const char* msg =
4313 "Logging System Fatal Error:\n"
4314 "File writer thread failed while running. "
4315 "The application cannot continue safely without logging support and will now exit.\n\n"
4316 "Error: Unknown exception";
4317
4318 // logs, shows out-of-process message box, terminates the process
4319 npiFatl << msg;
4320
4321 // hard fallback if fatal handling unexpectedly returns
4322 std::abort();
4323 }
4324 });
4325 }
4326 catch (const std::system_error& e) {
4327 cleanup(worker);
4328
4329 const QString msg = QStringLiteral(
4330 "Logging System Fatal Error:\n"
4331 "File writer thread failed to start. "
4332 "The application cannot continue safely without logging support and will now exit.\n\n"
4333 "Error: %1 (code %2)")
4334 .arg(QString::fromLocal8Bit(e.what()))
4335 .arg(e.code().value());
4336
4337 // logs, shows out-of-process message box, terminates the process
4338 npiFatl << msg;
4339
4340 // hard fallback if fatal handling unexpectedly returns
4341 std::abort();
4342 }
4343 catch (...) {
4344 cleanup(worker);
4345
4346 const char* msg =
4347 "Logging System Fatal Error:\n"
4348 "File writer thread failed to start. "
4349 "The application cannot continue safely without logging support and will now exit.\n\n"
4350 "Error: Unknown exception";
4351
4352 // logs, shows out-of-process message box, terminates the process
4353 npiFatl << msg;
4354
4355 // hard fallback if fatal handling unexpectedly returns
4356 std::abort();
4357 }
4358 }

4360 /// \brief Starts a detached cleanup operation for managed normal log files.
4361 /// \details Cleanup is serialized across application processes, keeps the newest matching
4362 /// files, and stops deleting once the configured combined size is satisfied.
4363 void directoryCleanup(QString directoryPath, std::uint32_t maximumSize)
4364 {
4365 // A newer cleanup request invalidates every older detached cleanup operation.
4366 const auto seq = LeakedState::Inst_().run_.dirCleanupSeq_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1u;
4367
4368 if (maximumSize < 1) return; // Values below one represent an unlimited directory size.
4369
4370 try {
4371 std::thread([seq, dirPath = std::move(directoryPath), maxSize = maximumSize]
4372 {
4373 try {
4374 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
4375
4376 if (seq != leaked.run_.dirCleanupSeq_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
4377 return;
4378
4379 // Only one process may calculate and delete from the shared directory at a time.
4380 npi::app::CrossProcessLocker locker{leaked.dirCleaningLockName_};
4381
4382 if (seq != leaked.run_.dirCleanupSeq_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
4383 return;
4384
4385 QDir dir(dirPath);
4386 if (!dir.exists())
4387 return;
4388
4389 std::uint64_t maxBytes;
4390 const std::uint64_t maxMb = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(maxSize);
4391 if (maxMb > (std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max() / (1024ULL * 1024ULL)))
4392 maxBytes = std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max();
4393 else
4394 maxBytes = maxMb * 1024ULL * 1024ULL;
4395
4396 // Important logs and unrelated files are excluded by the owned normal-log pattern.
4397 // The owned normal log has the following name pattern "xxxxxxxx_xxxxxxxxx_Phhhhhhhh.log"
4398 // where "x" is decimal digit and "h" is hexadecimal digit.
4399 const QRegularExpression logFilePattern{QStringLiteral(R"(^\d{8}_\d{9}_P[0-9A-F]{8}\.log$)")};
4400
4401 // Get the list of all files ending with ".log"
4402 auto fileInfoList = dir.entryInfoList({"*.log"}, QDir::Files | QDir::NoSymLinks,
4403 QDir::Time | QDir::Reversed);
4404
4405 // Remove unmatched files, this is so that we do not accidentally delete unwanted file.
4406 fileInfoList.removeIf([&logFilePattern](const QFileInfo& fileInfo)
4407 {
4408 return !logFilePattern.match(fileInfo.fileName()).hasMatch();
4409 });
4410
4411 std::uint64_t curBytes = 0;
4412 for (const QFileInfo& fi : fileInfoList)
4413 curBytes += static_cast<std::uint64_t>(fi.size());
4414
4415 if (curBytes > maxBytes) {
4416 for (const QFileInfo& fi : fileInfoList) {
4417 // Check if a new directory cleaning command has been issued, if yes
4418 // then we exit the current cleanup immediately.
4419 if (seq != leaked.run_.dirCleanupSeq_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
4420 return;
4421
4422 const std::uint64_t fileSize = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(fi.size());
4423 if (QFile::remove(fi.absoluteFilePath()))
4424 curBytes -= fileSize;
4425
4426 if (curBytes <= maxBytes)
4427 break;
4428 }
4429 }
4430 }
4431 catch (const std::exception& e) {
4432 const QString msg = QStringLiteral(
4433 "Logging System:\n"
4434 "Log directory cleanup failed.\n\n"
4435 "Error: %1").arg(QString::fromLocal8Bit(e.what()));
4436 npiCrit << msg;
4437 npi::app::winWarnMsgExe(msg);
4438 }
4439 catch (...) {
4440 const char* msg =
4441 "Logging System:\n"
4442 "Log directory cleanup failed.\n\n"
4443 "Error: Unknown exception";
4444 npiCrit << msg;
4445 npi::app::winWarnMsgExe(msg);
4446 }
4447 }).detach();
4448 }
4449 catch (const std::exception& e) {
4450 const QString msg = QStringLiteral(
4451 "Logging System:\n"
4452 "Unable to start log directory cleanup.\n\n"
4453 "Error: %1").arg(QString::fromLocal8Bit(e.what()));
4454 npiCrit << msg;
4455 npi::app::winWarnMsgExe(msg);
4456 }
4457 catch (...) {
4458 const char* msg =
4459 "Logging System:\n"
4460 "Unable to start log directory cleanup.\n\n"
4461 "Error: Unknown exception";
4462 npiCrit << msg;
4463 npi::app::winWarnMsgExe(msg);
4464 }
4465 }
4466 }

4610 /// \brief Normalizes, validates, creates, and write-tests a log directory.
4611 QString checkAndValidateDir(const QString& path, QString* errorText)
4612 {
4613 // The validation now matches npiImpLog.exe:
4614 // - Accepts drive - letter absolute paths such as C:\Logs
4615 // - Accepts mapped network drives such as Z:\Logs
4616 // - Rejects UNC paths such as \\server\share\Logs
4617 // - Rejects drive - relative paths such as C:Logs
4618 // - Rejects malformed or non - ASCII drive prefixes
4619
4620 if (errorText)
4621 errorText->clear();
4622
4623 const auto setError = [errorText](const QString& text)
4624 {
4625 if (errorText)
4626 *errorText = text;
4627 };
4628
4629 const QString trimmed = path.trimmed();
4630
4631 if (trimmed.isEmpty()) {
4632 setError(
4633 QStringLiteral("Empty or white-space only directory path was provided, the path has been rejected.")
4634 );
4635 return {};
4636 }
4637
4638 QDir dir{trimmed};
4639
4640 if (!dir.isAbsolute()) {
4641 setError(
4642 QStringLiteral(
4643 "The provided directory path is not absolute:\n"
4644 "%1\n\n"
4645 "An absolute path must include its root location, for example:\n"
4646 "C:/Users/User/Documents/Application/Logs.")
4647 .arg(QDir::toNativeSeparators(trimmed))
4648 );
4649 return {};
4650 }
4651
4652 const QString cleanAbs = QDir::cleanPath(dir.absolutePath());
4653 const QString displayPath = QDir::toNativeSeparators(cleanAbs);
4654
4655#ifdef Q_OS_WIN
4656 const bool isDriveAbsolute =
4657 displayPath.size() >= 3 &&
4658 ((displayPath[0] >= u'A' && displayPath[0] <= u'Z') ||
4659 (displayPath[0] >= u'a' && displayPath[0] <= u'z')) &&
4660 displayPath[1] == u':' &&
4661 displayPath[2] == u'\\';
4662
4663 if (!isDriveAbsolute) {
4664 setError(
4665 QStringLiteral(
4666 "The provided directory path is not a supported drive-letter absolute path:\n"
4667 "%1\n\n"
4668 "Only absolute paths beginning with a drive letter are supported, "
4669 "for example:\n"
4670 "C:\\Users\\User\\Documents\\Application\\Logs.\n\n"
4671 "UNC paths such as \\\\server\\share\\Logs are not supported.")
4672 .arg(displayPath)
4673 );
4674 return {};
4675 }
4676#endif
4677
4678 const QFileInfo fileInfo{cleanAbs};
4679
4680 if (fileInfo.exists() && !fileInfo.isDir()) {
4681 setError(
4682 QStringLiteral(
4683 "The selected path cannot be used as a directory:\n"
4684 "%1\n\n"
4685 "A file or another non-directory filesystem object already exists "
4686 "at this location. Select a different directory path or remove the "
4687 "existing object.")
4688 .arg(displayPath)
4689 );
4690 return {};
4691 }
4692
4693 QDir cleanDir{cleanAbs};
4694
4695 if (!cleanDir.exists() && !cleanDir.mkpath(QStringLiteral("."))) {
4696 setError(
4697 QStringLiteral(
4698 "The directory could not be created:\n"
4699 "%1\n\n"
4700 "Possible causes include:\n"
4701 "- The application does not have permission to create the directory.\n"
4702 "- A parent directory does not exist or is inaccessible.\n"
4703 "- A file already exists somewhere in the requested path.\n"
4704 "- The path contains an invalid or unsupported component.")
4705 .arg(displayPath)
4706 );
4707 return {};
4708 }
4709
4710 QTemporaryFile temporaryFile{
4711 cleanDir.filePath(QStringLiteral("npi_rw_check_XXXXXX.tmp"))
4712 };
4713
4714 temporaryFile.setAutoRemove(true);
4715
4716 if (!temporaryFile.open()) {
4717 setError(
4718 QStringLiteral(
4719 "The directory exists but is not writable:\n"
4720 "%1\n\n"
4721 "The application could not create a temporary test file in this "
4722 "directory.\n\n"
4723 "System error:\n"
4724 "%2\n\n"
4725 "Check the directory permissions, security settings, available disk "
4726 "space, and whether the location is currently accessible.")
4727 .arg(displayPath, temporaryFile.errorString())
4728 );
4729 return {};
4730 }
4731
4732 return cleanAbs; // NOLINT(clang-diagnostic-nrvo, performance-no-automatic-move)
4733 }
4734
4735 /// \brief Compares two Windows paths using normalized case-insensitive semantics.
4736 bool comparePaths(const QString& a, const QString& b)
4737 {
4738 // Fast check to avoid object allocation
4739 if (!a.isEmpty() && a == b)
4740 return true;
4741
4742 const QString aTrim = a.trimmed();
4743 const QString bTrim = b.trimmed();
4744 if (aTrim.isEmpty() || bTrim.isEmpty())
4745 return false;
4746
4747 // static checking for absolute paths
4748 if (!QDir::isAbsolutePath(aTrim) || !QDir::isAbsolutePath(bTrim))
4749 return false;
4750
4751 const QString aClean = QDir::cleanPath(aTrim);
4752 const QString bClean = QDir::cleanPath(bTrim);
4753
4754#ifdef Q_OS_WIN
4755 return aClean.compare(bClean, Qt::CaseInsensitive) == 0;
4756#else
4757 return aClean == bClean;
4758#endif
4759 }
4760
4761 /// \brief Normalizes and validates custom Qt category-filter rules.
4762 QStringList cleanedFilterRulesList(const QStringList& list)
4763 {
4764 QStringList out;
4765 out.reserve(list.size());
4766
4767 for (const QString& raw : list) {
4768 if (raw.isEmpty())
4769 continue;
4770
4771 QString s = raw;
4772 s.removeIf([](const QChar ch) { return ch.isSpace(); }); // handles tabs, etc.
4773
4774 const auto eq = s.indexOf('=');
4775 if (eq <= 0)
4776 continue; // rejects "" and "=true"
4777 if (eq != s.lastIndexOf('='))
4778 continue; // rejects "a=b=c"
4779
4780 const QString key = s.left(eq);
4781 QString val = s.mid(eq + 1).toLower();
4782
4783 if (key.isEmpty())
4784 continue;
4785 if (val != "true" && val != "false")
4786 continue;
4787
4788 out.append(key + "=" + val);
4789 }
4790
4791 return out;
4792 }
