4794 /// \brief Loads and validates the complete persisted logging configuration.
4795 /// \details Invalid or default-valued entries are removed so the settings file retains only meaningful overrides.
4796 LeakedState::Config loadAllSettings()
4797 {
4798 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
4799
4800 LeakedState::Config config{
4801 .directory_ = leaked.defDirectory_,
4802 .fileFields_ = leaked.defFileFieldsText_,
4803 .dispFields_ = leaked.defDispFieldsText_,
4804 .filterRules_ = QStringList{}
4805 };
4806
4807 QSettings::Status status{QSettings::NoError};
4808
4809 {
4810 npi::app::CrossProcessLocker locker{leaked.settingsLockName_};
4811 QSettings settings{
4812 QDir(npi::app::appProgramDataDir()).filePath(settingsFileName.toString()), QSettings::IniFormat
4813 };
4814
4815 // Directory
4816 QString curDir;
4817 if (settings.contains(settingsDirectoryKey.toString())) {
4818 const QString path = settings.value(settingsDirectoryKey.toString()).toString().trimmed();
4819 if (path.isEmpty() || comparePaths(path, leaked.defDirectory_)) {
4820 settings.remove(settingsDirectoryKey.toString());
4821 }
4822 else {
4823 QString errorText;
4824 const QString cleanPath = checkAndValidateDir(path, &errorText);
4825 if (cleanPath.isEmpty()) {
4826 npiWarn << QStringLiteral(
4827 "Unable to use %1 as log directory, falling back to the default log directory. Error: %2").arg(
4828 path, errorText);
4829 settings.remove(settingsDirectoryKey.toString());
4830 }
4831 else {
4832 curDir = cleanPath;
4833 settings.setValue(settingsDirectoryKey.toString(), curDir);
4834 }
4835 }
4836 }
4837
4838 if (curDir.isEmpty()) {
4839 QString errorText;
4840 curDir = checkAndValidateDir(leaked.defDirectory_, &errorText);
4841 if (curDir.isEmpty()) {
4842 npi::app::winStopMsgExe(QStringLiteral("Logging System Fatal Error:\n"
4843 "Unable to create default log directory at '%1', This folder is required to store application logs.\n\n"
4844 "The application cannot continue safely without logging support and will now exit.\n\n"
4845 "Error: %2")
4846 .arg(leaked.defDirectory_, errorText));
4847 }
4848 }
4849
4850 // Max Folder Size MB
4851 std::uint32_t maxFolderMb{defMaxFolderMb};
4852 if (settings.contains(settingsMaxFolderSizeKey.toString())) {
4853 bool maxSizeOk{false};
4854 const qulonglong stored = settings.value(settingsMaxFolderSizeKey.toString(),
4855 defMaxFolderMb).toULongLong(&maxSizeOk);
4856 if (maxSizeOk
4857 && stored <= std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()
4858 && stored != defMaxFolderMb)
4859 maxFolderMb = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(stored);
4860 else
4861 settings.remove(settingsMaxFolderSizeKey.toString());
4862 }
4863
4864 // File Fields
4865 QString fileFields{leaked.defFileFieldsText_};
4866 if (settings.contains(settingsFileFieldsKey.toString())) {
4867 auto stored = settings.value(settingsFileFieldsKey.toString()).toString();
4868 stored = layout::normalizeAndPackFields(stored, leaked.defFileFields_);
4869 if (stored == fileFields) {
4870 settings.remove(settingsFileFieldsKey.toString());
4871 }
4872 else {
4873 settings.setValue(settingsFileFieldsKey.toString(), stored);
4874 fileFields = stored;
4875 }
4876 }
4877
4878 // Display Fields
4879 QString dispFields{leaked.defDispFieldsText_};
4880 if (settings.contains(settingsDispFieldsKey.toString())) {
4881 auto stored = settings.value(settingsDispFieldsKey.toString()).toString();
4882 stored = layout::normalizeAndPackFields(stored, leaked.defDispFields_);
4883 if (stored == dispFields) {
4884 settings.remove(settingsDispFieldsKey.toString());
4885 }
4886 else {
4887 settings.setValue(settingsDispFieldsKey.toString(), stored);
4888 dispFields = stored;
4889 }
4890 }
4891
4892 // Filter Rules
4893 QStringList filterRules;
4894 if (settings.contains(settingsFilterRulesKey.toString())) {
4895 const QStringList ruleList = settings.value(settingsFilterRulesKey.toString()).toStringList();
4896 filterRules = cleanedFilterRulesList(ruleList);
4897 if (filterRules.isEmpty())
4898 settings.remove(settingsFilterRulesKey.toString());
4899 else
4900 settings.setValue(settingsFilterRulesKey.toString(), filterRules);
4901 }
4902
4903 // Warning Log is Important
4904 bool warnIsImp{defWarnIsImp};
4905 if (settings.contains(settingsWarnIsImpKey.toString())) {
4906 const auto stored = settings.value(settingsWarnIsImpKey.toString()).toBool();
4907 if (stored == warnIsImp)
4908 settings.remove(settingsWarnIsImpKey.toString());
4909 else
4910 warnIsImp = stored;
4911 }
4912
4913 // Show warning logs in display
4914 bool showWarnLog{defShowWarnLog};
4915 if (settings.contains(settingsShowWarnLogKey.toString())) {
4916 const auto stored = settings.value(settingsShowWarnLogKey.toString()).toBool();
4917 if (stored == showWarnLog)
4918 settings.remove(settingsShowWarnLogKey.toString());
4919 else
4920 showWarnLog = stored;
4921 }
4922
4923 // Show info logs in display
4924 bool showInfoLog{defShowInfoLog};
4925 if (settings.contains(settingsShowInfoLogKey.toString())) {
4926 const auto stored = settings.value(settingsShowInfoLogKey.toString()).toBool();
4927 if (stored == showInfoLog)
4928 settings.remove(settingsShowInfoLogKey.toString());
4929 else
4930 showInfoLog = stored;
4931 }
4932
4933 // Show debug logs in display
4934 bool showDbugLog{defShowDbugLog};
4935 if (settings.contains(settingsShowDbugLogKey.toString())) {
4936 const auto stored = settings.value(settingsShowDbugLogKey.toString()).toBool();
4937 if (stored == showDbugLog)
4938 settings.remove(settingsShowDbugLogKey.toString());
4939 else
4940 showDbugLog = stored;
4941 }
4942
4943 // Colored console based on log level
4944 bool coloredConsole{defColoredConsole};
4945 if (settings.contains(settingsColoredConsoleKey.toString())) {
4946 const auto stored = settings.value(settingsColoredConsoleKey.toString()).toBool();
4947 if (stored == coloredConsole)
4948 settings.remove(settingsColoredConsoleKey.toString());
4949 else
4950 coloredConsole = stored;
4951 }
4952
4953 config.directory_ = curDir;
4954 config.maxFolderMb_ = maxFolderMb;
4955 config.fileFields_ = fileFields;
4956 config.dispFields_ = dispFields;
4957 config.filterRules_ = filterRules;
4958 config.warnIsImp_ = warnIsImp;
4959 config.showWarnLog_ = showWarnLog;
4960 config.showInfoLog_ = showInfoLog;
4961 config.showDbugLog_ = showDbugLog;
4962 config.coloredConsole_ = coloredConsole;
4963
4964 settings.sync();
4965 status = settings.status();
4966 }
4967
4968 if (status != QSettings::NoError) {
4969 showWarnMsg(
4970 QStringLiteral(
4971 "Logging System Settings Warning:\n"
4972 "The stored logging configuration could not be loaded or updated reliably.\n\n"
4973 "Status: %1\n\n"
4974 "The application will continue using the settings that could be read and "
4975 "default values for anything unavailable.")
4976 .arg(settingsStatusText(status))
4977 );
4978 }
4979
4980 return config;
4981 }

4983 /// \brief Transitions both normal and important logging to a new directory.
4984 /// \details Starts the new important-log helper, publishes the normal-log path,
4985 /// wakes or starts the file worker, waits for its acknowledgement, and then
4986 /// publishes the shared file base name.
4987 void useDirectory(const QString& directory)
4988 {
4989 // Create the file base name here; this is its only generation point.
4990 const QString fileBaseName = QDateTime::currentDateTime().toString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmsszzz")
4991 .append(QStringLiteral("_P%1")
4992 .arg(
4993 static_cast<quint32>(::GetCurrentProcessId()),
4994 8, 16, QLatin1Char('0')).toUpper());
4995
4996 // Start the important log process, failure usually results in application termination.
4997 bridge::startProcess(directory, fileBaseName);
4998
4999 // Get the normal log full file path. Store the full file path in the file
5000 // worker state then wakeup or start file worker and wait for its acknowledgement
5001 // through fileReady_ atomic bool. Only after this publish this base file name.
5002 // Any errors in changing the log file usually results in immediate application termination.
5003 const QString fileFullPath = QDir(directory).filePath(fileBaseName + QStringLiteral(".log"));
5004 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
5005 leaked.file_.fileReady_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
5006 leaked.file_.fileFullPath_.write_(fileFullPath);
5007 if (leaked.file_.worker_.active_.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
5008 workers::wakeup(leaked.file_.worker_);
5009 else
5010 workers::fileWorkerStart();
5011 leaked.file_.fileReady_.wait(false, std::memory_order_acquire);
5012 leaked.run_.fileBaseName_.write_(fileBaseName);
5013 }

5015 /// \brief Installs the built-in and normalized custom Qt category filters.
5016 void setFilterRules(const QStringList& cleanedFilterRules = {})
5017 {
5018 QString rules{baseFilterRule.toString()};
5019 if (!cleanedFilterRules.isEmpty())
5020 rules.append('\n').append(cleanedFilterRules.join('\n'));
5021 QLoggingCategory::setFilterRules(rules);
5022 }

5024 /// \brief Persists the most recently scheduled maximum-folder-size value.
5025 void saveMaxFolderMbPendingValue()
5026 {
5027 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
5028 const auto value = leaked.run_.maxFolderMbPendingSaveValue_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
5029 if (value == defMaxFolderMb)
5030 removeSettings(settingsMaxFolderSizeKey);
5031 else
5032 saveSettings(settingsMaxFolderSizeKey, value);
5033 }
5034
5035 /// \brief Debounces persistence of a non-temporary maximum-folder-size change.
5036 void scheduleMaxFolderMbSave(std::uint32_t maxFolderMb)
5037 {
5038 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
5039
5040 if (leaked.run_.tempMode_.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
5041 return;
5042
5043 leaked.run_.maxFolderMbPendingSaveValue_.store(maxFolderMb, std::memory_order_release);
5044
5045 QCoreApplication* app = QCoreApplication::instance();
5046 if (app == nullptr) {
5047 saveMaxFolderMbPendingValue();
5048 return;
5049 }
5050
5051 auto startTimer = []
5052 {
5053 LeakedState& state = LeakedState::Inst_();
5054
5055 if (!state.run_.maxFolderMbSaveTimer_) {
5056 state.run_.maxFolderMbSaveTimer_ = std::make_unique<QTimer>();
5057 QTimer& timer = *state.run_.maxFolderMbSaveTimer_;
5058 timer.setSingleShot(true);
5059 timer.setInterval(maxFolderTimerTimeoutMs);
5060
5061 QObject::connect(&timer, &QTimer::timeout, &timer, [] { saveMaxFolderMbPendingValue(); });
5062
5063 // On application close, any pending save should be executed immediately.
5064 QObject::connect(QCoreApplication::instance(), &QCoreApplication::aboutToQuit, &timer, []
5065 {
5066 LeakedState& leakedState = LeakedState::Inst_();
5067 if (leakedState.run_.maxFolderMbSaveTimer_->isActive()) {
5068 leakedState.run_.maxFolderMbSaveTimer_->stop();
5069 saveMaxFolderMbPendingValue();
5070 }
5071 });
5072 }
5073
5074 state.run_.maxFolderMbSaveTimer_->start();
5075 };
5076
5077 if (QThread::currentThread() == app->thread()) {
5078 startTimer();
5079 }
5080 else if (!QMetaObject::invokeMethod(app, std::move(startTimer), Qt::QueuedConnection)) {
5081 saveMaxFolderMbPendingValue();
5082 const char* msg = "Logging System:\nUnable to schedule maximum log folder size save.";
5083 npiWarn << msg;
5084 npi::app::winWarnMsgExe(msg);
5085 }
5086 }
5087
5088 /// \brief Updates the runtime maximum-folder-size setting.
5089 /// \details Cleanup is debounced only when the runtime value changes, while persistence
5090 /// is independently debounced whenever temporary mode is disabled.
5091 void setMaxFolderMb(std::uint32_t maxFolderMb)
5092 {
5093 scheduleMaxFolderMbSave(maxFolderMb);
5094
5095 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
5096
5097 const bool changed = leaked.cfg_.writeWith_(
5098 [maxFolderMb](LeakedState::Config& cfg)
5099 {
5100 if (cfg.maxFolderMb_ == maxFolderMb)
5101 return false;
5102
5103 cfg.maxFolderMb_ = maxFolderMb;
5104 return true;
5105 });
5106
5107 if (!changed)
5108 return;
5109
5110 QCoreApplication* app = QCoreApplication::instance();
5111 if (app == nullptr)
5112 return;
5113
5114 auto startTimer = []
5115 {
5116 LeakedState& state = LeakedState::Inst_();
5117
5118 if (!state.run_.maxFolderMbCleanupTimer_) {
5119 state.run_.maxFolderMbCleanupTimer_ = std::make_unique<QTimer>();
5120 QTimer& timer = *state.run_.maxFolderMbCleanupTimer_;
5121 timer.setSingleShot(true);
5122 timer.setInterval(maxFolderTimerTimeoutMs);
5123
5124 QObject::connect(&timer, &QTimer::timeout, &timer, []
5125 {
5126 LeakedState& leakedState = LeakedState::Inst_();
5127 const auto values = leakedState.cfg_.readWith_(
5128 [](const LeakedState::Config& cfg)
5129 {
5130 return std::pair{cfg.directory_, cfg.maxFolderMb_};
5131 });
5132 workers::directoryCleanup(values.first, values.second);
5133 });
5134 }
5135
5136 state.run_.maxFolderMbCleanupTimer_->start();
5137 };
5138
5139 if (QThread::currentThread() == app->thread()) {
5140 startTimer();
5141 }
5142 else if (!QMetaObject::invokeMethod(app, std::move(startTimer), Qt::QueuedConnection)) {
5143 const char* msg = "Logging System:\nUnable to schedule maximum log folder size cleanup.";
5144 npiWarn << msg;
5145 npi::app::winWarnMsgExe(msg);
5146 }
5147 }
5148
5149 /// \brief Allocates the next compact thread index with saturation.
5150 std::uint16_t nextThreadIndex(std::atomic_uint16_t& generator) noexcept
5151 {
5152 std::uint16_t current{generator.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)};
5153 while (current < std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max()) {
5154 const std::uint16_t next{static_cast<std::uint16_t>(current + 1u)};
5155 if (generator.compare_exchange_weak(
5156 current,
5157 next,
5158 std::memory_order_relaxed,
5159 std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
5160 return current;
5161 }
5162 }
5163 return std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max();
5164 }
5165 }
5166
5167 /// \brief Records encountered categories and forwards filtering to the previous handler.
5168 void logCategoryFilter(QLoggingCategory* category)
5169 {
5170 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
5171
5172 // Keep a unique list of encountered categories for runtime queries and UI display.
5173 if (auto name = category->categoryName(); name) {
5174 const QString cat{QString::fromLatin1(name)};
5175 auto categories = leaked.run_.categories_.writeAccess_();
5176 if (!categories->contains(cat))
5177 categories->append(cat);
5178 }
5179
5180 // Forward the category to default Qt filter for default processing since we
5181 // are only using this function to collect category names.
5182 if (auto prev = leaked.run_.prevCategoryFilter_.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
5183 prev(category);
5184 }
5185
5186 /// \brief Captures and routes one message delivered by Qt.
5187 /// \details The handler assigns timing and context-cache slots, queues normal output,
5188 /// forwards important output, and enters fatal handling when required.
5189 void logMsgHandler(QtMsgType typ, const QMessageLogContext& ctx, const QString& msg) noexcept
5190 {
5191 const char* stage = "Entry";
5192 std::uint32_t seq = 0;
5193 bool fatalLogOwned = false;
5194
5195 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
5196 const DWORD selfThreadId = ::GetCurrentThreadId();
5197
5198 try {
5199 // Capture all compact metadata before the record is handed to another thread.
5200 stage = "Sequence";
5201 seq = leaked.run_.logSequence_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
5202
5203 stage = "Thread Index";
5204 const thread_local std::uint16_t threadIndex = (selfThreadId == leaked.mainThreadId_)
5205 ? 1u
5206 : control::nextThreadIndex(leaked.run_.threadIndexGenerator_);
5207
5208 stage = "Time capture";
5209 const auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
5210 const qint64 nowNs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(nowTp - leaked.startTp_).count();
5211
5212 const std::uint32_t appTimeMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
5213 std::min<qint64>(nowNs / 1000000, std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()));
5214
5215 thread_local const qint64 threadBegNs = nowNs;
5216 const qint64 threadTimeNs = nowNs - threadBegNs;
5217
5218 const std::uint32_t threadTimeMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
5219 std::min<qint64>(threadTimeNs / 1000000, std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()));
5220
5221 thread_local qint64 prevThreadNs = 0;
5222 const qint64 threadDelta = (prevThreadNs > 0) ? nowNs - prevThreadNs : 0;
5223 prevThreadNs = nowNs;
5224
5225 stage = "Category cache";
5226 const std::uint8_t categorySlot = leaked.categoryCache_.slot_(ctx);
5227
5228 stage = "File Line Cache";
5229 const std::uint16_t fileLineSlot = leaked.fileLineCache_.slot_(ctx);
5230
5231 stage = "Function Cache";
5232 const std::uint16_t functionSlot = leaked.functionCache_.slot_(ctx);
5233
5234 stage = "OneLog construction";
5235 OneLog log{
5236 .level_ = OneLog::LevelCast_(typ),
5237 .category_ = categorySlot,
5238 .threadIdx_ = threadIndex,
5239 .fileLine_ = fileLineSlot,
5240 .function_ = functionSlot,
5241 .threadId_ = selfThreadId,
5242 .sequence_ = seq,
5243 .appTimeMs_ = appTimeMs,
5244 .threadTimeMs_ = threadTimeMs,
5245 .threadDeltaNs_ = threadDelta,
5246 .dateTime_ = std::chrono::system_clock::now(),
5247 .message_ = msg
5248 };
5249
5250 // Late records arrive after the registered exit callback enables shutdown mode.
5251 const bool late = leaked.run_.shutdownMode_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
5252
5253 // Fatal records bypass the asynchronous queues so their important-log entry,
5254 // debugger output, and popup are completed by the owning thread.
5255 stage = "Fatal log check";
5256 if (typ == QtFatalMsg) {
5257 // Prevents the SIGABRT handler from writing a duplicate crash log for the known Qt fatal path.
5258 crash::claimFatalOwnership(leaked.crash_, selfThreadId);
5259 fatalLogOwned = true;
5260
5261 stage = "Fatal log formatting";
5262 leaked.crash_.fatalBuf_.clear_();
5263 format::bridgeLog(leaked.crash_.fatalBuf_, log, late);
5264
5265 // Send to important log process.
5266 stage = "Fatal log send";
5267 bridge::sendData(leaked.crash_.fatalBuf_.data_(), leaked.crash_.fatalBuf_.size_(), true);
5268
5269 // Show in debugger if present
5270 stage = "Fatal debug output";
5271 if (::IsDebuggerPresent()) {
5272 leaked.crash_.fatalDebugBuf_.clear_();
5273 format::appendLevel(leaked.crash_.fatalDebugBuf_, log, false);
5274 format::appendSequence(leaked.crash_.fatalDebugBuf_, log, false);
5275 format::appendThreadId(leaked.crash_.fatalDebugBuf_, log, false);
5276 format::appendMessage(leaked.crash_.fatalDebugBuf_, log, false, late);
5277 leaked.crash_.fatalDebugBuf_.finalizeAsNewLine_();
5278 ::OutputDebugStringA(leaked.crash_.fatalDebugBuf_.data_());
5279 }
5280
5281 // Show as a popup. The winStopMsgExe terminates the application
5282 // after call npiMsgExe process to show popup and does not return.
5283 stage = "Fatal popup";
5284 leaked.crash_.fatalPopupBuf_.clear_();
5285 leaked.crash_.fatalPopupBuf_.appendRawTextFast_("Fatal Error:\n");
5286 leaked.crash_.fatalPopupBuf_.appendText_(msg);
5287 leaked.crash_.fatalPopupBuf_.finalize_();
5288 npi::app::winStopMsgExe(leaked.crash_.fatalPopupBuf_.data_());
5289 }
5290
5291 // Critical records are written synchronously to the important log. Records
5292 // arriving after shutdown begins also bypass workers because they may be gone.
5293 if (typ == QtCriticalMsg || late) {
5294 TextBuffer<4096u> buf;
5295 format::bridgeLog(buf, log, late);
5296 bridge::sendDataLocked(buf.data_(), buf.size_(), false);
5297 if (late) {
5298 if (::IsDebuggerPresent()) {
5299 buf.clear_();
5300 format::appendLevel(buf, log, false);
5301 format::appendSequence(buf, log, false);
5302 format::appendThreadId(buf, log, false);
5303 format::appendMessage(buf, log, false, late);
5304 buf.finalizeAsNewLine_();
5305 ::OutputDebugStringA(buf.data_());
5306 }
5307 return;
5308 }
5309 }
5310
5311 // All remaining records enter the file queue; the file worker is responsible
5312 // for normal-file output and optional forwarding to the display queue.
5313 thread_local moodycamel::ProducerToken pFileToken{leaked.file_.worker_.queue_};
5314 if (leaked.file_.worker_.queue_.enqueue(pFileToken, std::move(log)))
5315 workers::wakeup(leaked.file_.worker_);
5316 else
5317 leaked.file_.droppedLogs_.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
5318 }
5319 catch (...) {
5320 // Logging failure must not kill the application for non-fatal messages.
5321 if (typ != QtFatalMsg)
5322 return;
5323
5324 if (!fatalLogOwned)
5325 crash::claimFatalOwnership(leaked.crash_, selfThreadId);
5326
5327 TextBuffer<512> buf;
5328 buf.appendRawTextFast_("Log.cpp logMsgHandler() Exception; Sequence: ");
5329 buf.appendDec_(seq);
5330 buf.appendRawTextFast_("; Level: FATAL; Stage: ");
5331 buf.appendText_(stage);
5332 buf.finalizeAsNewLine_();
5333 bridge::sendData(buf.data_(), buf.size_(), true);
5334
5335 npi::app::winStopMsgExe(
5336 "Fatal Error:\nLog.cpp logMsgHandler() exception occurred while handling a Qt fatal message.");
5337 }
5338 }
5339
5340 /// \brief Initializes the logging system during process startup.
5341 /// \details Persistent settings, category filtering, crash handlers, message handling,
5342 /// workers, and initial directory cleanup are established in dependency order.
5343 void startup()
5344 {
5345 static std::once_flag once;
5346 std::call_once(once, []
5347 {
5348 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
5349
5350 // Install emergency handling before Qt begins routing messages through this system.
5351 crash::installCrashHandlers();
5352 qInstallMessageHandler(logMsgHandler);
5353 auto oldLogCategoryFilter = QLoggingCategory::installFilter(logCategoryFilter);
5354 leaked.run_.prevCategoryFilter_.store(oldLogCategoryFilter, std::memory_order_release);
5355
5356 // Load and publish the complete runtime configuration before starting workers.
5357 const auto cfg = control::loadAllSettings();
5358 leaked.cfg_.write_(cfg);
5359 control::setFilterRules(cfg.filterRules_);
5360 workers::directoryCleanup(cfg.directory_, cfg.maxFolderMb_);
5361 layout::normalizeAndPackFields(cfg.fileFields_, leaked.defFileFields_, &leaked.file_.worker_.packedFields_);
5362 layout::normalizeAndPackFields(cfg.dispFields_, leaked.defDispFields_, &leaked.disp_.worker_.packedFields_);
5363 workers::dispWorkerStart();
5364 control::useDirectory(cfg.directory_);
5365
5366 // Mark shutdown before stopping workers so late records use the synchronous path.
5367 if (std::atexit([]
5368 {
5369 LeakedState::Inst_().run_.shutdownMode_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
5370 workers::shutdown();
5371 }) != 0) {
5372 npiCrit << "Logging System: Unable to register shutdown process using 'std::atexit'.";
5373 }
5374 });
5375 }
5376
5377 // Initialize logging before control reaches the application entry point.
5378 Q_CONSTRUCTOR_FUNCTION(startup)
5379}

5400
5401QString npi::log::setDirectory(const QString& path)
5402{
5403 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
5404
5405 // Validate the path
5406 QString errorText;
5407 const QString newDir = control::checkAndValidateDir(path, &errorText);
5408 if (newDir.isEmpty()) {
5409 if (!errorText.isEmpty())
5410 control::showWarnMsg(errorText);
5411 return leaked.cfg_.read_(&LeakedState::Config::directory_);
5412 }
5413
5414 const bool newIsDef = control::comparePaths(newDir, leaked.defDirectory_);
5415
5416 // There are going to be significant changes, and so we lock the mutex to avoid
5417 // multiple threads trying to make changes at the same time.
5418 std::scoped_lock lock{leaked.run_.directoryChangeMutex_};
5419
5420 // Compare with current directory to make sure we have to make changes to
5421 // bridge, workers and directory cleanup.
5422 const QString curDir = leaked.cfg_.read_(&LeakedState::Config::directory_);
5423 if (control::comparePaths(newDir, curDir)) {
5424 if (!leaked.run_.tempMode_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
5425 // We store because the current directory if previously assigned while
5426 // temp mode was enabled would not have been stored in the settings.
5427 if (newIsDef)
5428 control::removeSettings(control::settingsDirectoryKey);
5429 else
5430 control::saveSettings(control::settingsDirectoryKey, newDir);
5431 }
5432 return curDir; // NOLINT(performance-no-automatic-move, clang-diagnostic-nrvo)
5433 }
5434
5435 // The control::useDirectory does things in this order:
5436 // - Create a new bridge process and close the old one.
5437 // - Set the correct variables for file change in file worker.
5438 // - Wakeup the file worker and wait till it signals that file has been changed.
5439 // If any of the above produces error then application terminates and the new
5440 // directory is not written to the settings file, this is intended as a safeguard.
5441 control::useDirectory(newDir);
5442
5443 // Only change the value in config after control::useDirectory is successful.
5444 leaked.cfg_.write_(&LeakedState::Config::directory_, newDir);
5445
5446 // Cleanup the new directory
5447 workers::directoryCleanup(newDir, leaked.cfg_.read_(&LeakedState::Config::maxFolderMb_));
5448
5449 // Change settings file if temp mode is disabled.
5450 if (!leaked.run_.tempMode_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
5451 if (newIsDef) control::removeSettings(control::settingsDirectoryKey);
5452 else control::saveSettings(control::settingsDirectoryKey, newDir);
5453 }
5454
5455 return newDir; // NOLINT(performance-no-automatic-move, clang-diagnostic-nrvo)
5456}
5457
5458QString npi::log::resetDirectory()
5459{
5460 LeakedState& leaked = LeakedState::Inst_();
5461
5462 // There are going to be significant changes, and so we lock the mutex to avoid
5463 // multiple threads trying to make changes at the same time.
5464 std::scoped_lock lock{leaked.run_.directoryChangeMutex_};
5465
5466 if (control::comparePaths(leaked.defDirectory_, leaked.cfg_.read_(&LeakedState::Config::directory_))) {
5467 if (!leaked.run_.tempMode_.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
5468 control::removeSettings(control::settingsDirectoryKey);
5469 return leaked.defDirectory_;
5470 }
5471
5472 // The control::useDirectory does things in this order:
5473 // - Create a new bridge process and close the old one.
5474 // - Set the correct variables for file change in file worker.
5475 // - Wakeup the file worker and wait till it signals that file has been changed.
5476 // If any of the above produces error then application terminates and the new
5477 // directory is not written to the settings file, this is intended as a safeguard.
5478 control::useDirectory(leaked.defDirectory_);
5479
5480 // Only change the value in config after control::useDirectory is successful.
5481 leaked.cfg_.write_(&LeakedState::Config::directory_, leaked.defDirectory_);
5482
5483 // Cleanup the new directory
5484 workers::directoryCleanup(leaked.defDirectory_, leaked.cfg_.read_(&LeakedState::Config::maxFolderMb_));
5485
5486 // Change settings file if temp mode is disabled.
5487 if (!leaked.run_.tempMode_.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
5488 control::removeSettings(control::settingsDirectoryKey);
5489
5490 return leaked.defDirectory_;
5491}
